title.zh: 卷六十七 志第二十 五行五
title.raw: 卷六十七 志第二十 五行五 Volume 67 Treatises 20: Five Elements 5

sentences.zh: 稼穡作甘，土之性也。

translations.literal: Crops and tillage produce sweetness—such is the nature of earth.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and silk ripen sweet—that is the nature of Earth.

sentences.zh: 土失其性，則為災兇。

translations.literal: When earth loses its nature, then there is calamity and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: When Earth forsakes its proper nature, calamity and misfortune follow.

sentences.zh: 舊說以恆風、脂夜之妖，華孽、臝蟲之孽，牛禍、黃眚、黃祥，皆屬之土，今從之。

translations.literal: Old accounts class constant wind, grease-at-night omens, flower aberrations, naked-insect calamities, cattle portents, yellow afflictions and yellow auspices all under earth; here we follow them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier accounts grouped constant wind, grease-at-night portents, flower aberrations, naked-insect calamities, cattle portents, and yellow afflictions and yellow auspices under Earth; this chapter follows that convention.

sentences.zh: 建隆元年，河南諸州乏食。

translations.literal: Jianlong year 1: the various prefectures of Henan lacked grain.
translations.idiomatic: Jianlong 1: the prefectures of Henan suffered food shortages.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年，齊、隰等州飢。

translations.literal: In Qiande 1, Qi, Xi, and other prefectures suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 1, Qi, Xi, and other prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二年，州府二十二飢。

translations.literal: In the second year, twenty-two prefectures and superior prefectures suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, twenty-two prefectures and superior prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 開寶四年，州府六水、一旱，諸州民乏食。

translations.literal: Kaibao year 4: six prefectures flood, one drought; in various prefectures the people lacked grain.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 4: six prefectures flooded and one suffered drought; the people across many prefectures lacked food.

sentences.zh: 五年，大饑。

translations.literal: Year 5: great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 5: a great famine.

sentences.zh: 六年，水，民飢。

translations.literal: Year 6: flood; the people famine.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 6: flooding; the people suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 九年，州府十二飢。

translations.literal: Year 9: twelve prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 9: twelve prefectures suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，太平州飢。

translations.literal: Taiping Xingguo year 4: Taiping Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 4: Taiping Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年，開封、河南等九州飢。

translations.literal: Chunhua year 1: Kaifeng, Henan, and nine other circuits famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 1: famine struck Kaifeng, Henan, and nine other circuits.

sentences.zh: 五年，京東西、淮南、陝西水潦，民飢。

translations.literal: Year 5: Jingdong East and West, Huainan, and Shaanxi flooded; the people famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 5: Jingdong East and West, Huainan, and Shaanxi were inundated, and the people suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 咸平五年，河北及鄭、曹、滑飢。

translations.literal: Xianping year 5: Hebei and Zheng, Cao, and Hua famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 5: famine in Hebei and at Zheng, Cao, and Hua.

sentences.zh: 景德元年，江南東、西路飢。

translations.literal: Jingde year 1: Jiangnan East and West circuits famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 1: famine in the Jiangnan East and West circuits.

sentences.zh: 二年，淮南、兩浙、荊湖北路飢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Huainan, the two Zhe circuits, and Jingbei North circuit famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 2: famine in Huainan, the two Zhe circuits, and the Jingbei North circuit.

sentences.zh: 三年，京東西、河北、陝西飢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Jingdong East and West, Hebei, and Shaanxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 3: famine in Jingdong East and West, Hebei, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符三年，陝西飢。

translations.literal: Dazhong Xiangfu year 3: Shaanxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 3: famine in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 四年，河北、陝西、劍南飢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Hebei, Shaanxi, and Jiannan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 4: famine in Hebei, Shaanxi, and Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 五年，河北、淮南飢。

translations.literal: Year 5: Hebei and Huainan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 5: famine in Hebei and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 七年，淮南、江、浙飢。

translations.literal: Year 7: Huainan, Jiang, and Zhe famine.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 7: famine in Huainan, Jiang, and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 八年，陝西州府五飢。

translations.literal: Year 8: five prefectures of Shaanxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 8: five prefectures in Shaanxi suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，飢。

translations.literal: Tianxi year 1: famine.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 1: famine.

sentences.zh: 三年，江、浙及利州路飢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Jiang, Zhe, and Lizhou circuit famine.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 3: famine in Jiang, Zhe, and the Lizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 天聖三年，晉、絳、陝、解飢。

translations.literal: Tiansheng year 3: Jin, Jiang, Shaan, and Xie famine.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng 3: famine at Jin, Jiang, Shaan, and Xie.

sentences.zh: 明道元年，京東、淮南、江東飢。

translations.literal: Mingdao year 1: Jingdong, Huainan, and Jiangdong famine.
translations.idiomatic: Mingdao 1: famine in Jingdong, Huainan, and Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 二年，淮南、江東、西川飢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Huainan, Jiangdong, and Xichuan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Mingdao 2: famine in Huainan, Jiangdong, and Xichuan.

sentences.zh: 寶元二年，益、梓、利、夔路飢。

translations.literal: Baoyuan year 2: Yi, Zi, Li, and Kui circuits famine.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyuan 2: famine in the Yi, Zi, Li, and Kui circuits.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐三年，夔州路旱，飢。

translations.literal: Jiayou year 3: Kuizhou circuit drought; famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 3: drought in the Kuizhou circuit, then famine.

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，河北、陝西旱。

translations.literal: Xining year 3: Hebei and Shaanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 3: drought in Hebei and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 四年，河北旱，飢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Hebei drought; famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 4: drought in Hebei, then famine.

sentences.zh: 六年，淮南、江東、劍南西川、潤州飢。

translations.literal: Year 6: Huainan, Jiangdong, Jiannan West, and Run Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 6: famine in Huainan, Jiangdong, Jiannan West, and Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，京畿、河北、京東西、淮西、成都、利州、延、常、潤、府州、威勝、保安軍飢。

translations.literal: Year 7: the capital region, Hebei, Jingdong East and West, Huaixi, Chengdu, Lizhou, Yan, Chang, Run, Fuzhou, Weisheng, and Bao'an Army famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 7: famine gripped the capital region, Hebei, Jingdong East and West, Huaixi, Chengdu, Lizhou, Yan, Chang, Run, Fuzhou, Weisheng, and Bao'an Army.

sentences.zh: 八年，兩河、陝西、江南、淮、浙飢。

translations.literal: Year 8: the two He regions, Shaanxi, Jiangnan, Huai, and Zhe famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 8: famine in the two He regions, Shaanxi, Jiangnan, Huai, and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 九年，雄州飢。

translations.literal: Year 9: Xiong Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 9: famine at Xiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十年，漳泉州、興化軍飢。

translations.literal: Year 10: Zhang and Quan prefectures and Xinghua Army famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 10: famine in Zhang and Quan prefectures and Xinghua Army.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，河北飢。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng year 1: Hebei famine.
translations.idiomatic: the first year of Yuanfeng: famine in Hebei.

sentences.zh: 四年，鳳翔府、鳳階州飢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Fengxiang Prefecture and Feng and Jie prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth year of Yuanfeng: famine at Fengxiang Prefecture and Feng and Jie prefectures.

sentences.zh: 七年，河東飢。

translations.literal: Year 7: Hedong famine.
translations.idiomatic: the seventh year of Yuanfeng: famine in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 元符二年，飢。

translations.literal: Yuanfu year 2: famine.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 2: famine.

sentences.zh: 崇寧元年，江、浙、熙河飢。

translations.literal: Chongning year 1: Jiang, Zhe, and Xihe famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 1: famine in Jiang, Zhe, and Xihe.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年，秦、鳳、階、成飢。

translations.literal: Daguan year 3: Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng famine.
translations.idiomatic: Daguan 3: famine at Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng.

sentences.zh: 重和元年，京西飢。

translations.literal: Chonghe year 1: Jingxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghe 1: famine in Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 五年，河北、京東、淮南飢。

translations.literal: Year 5: Hebei, Jingdong, and Huainan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghe 5: famine in Hebei, Jingdong, and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年，汴京大饑，米升錢三百，一鼠直數百錢，人食水藻、椿槐葉，道殣，骼無餘胔。

translations.literal: Jianyan year 1: Bianjing great famine; rice one sheng three hundred cash; one rat worth several hundred cash; people ate waterweed, ailanthus and locust leaves; corpses on the roads, bones with no flesh remaining.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyan 1: a great famine at Bianjing—rice sold for three hundred cash per sheng, a rat for several hundred; people ate waterweed and ailanthus and locust leaves; the roads were heaped with corpses stripped to the bone.

sentences.zh: 三年，山東郡國大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: Year 3: Shandong commanderies and kingdoms great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyan 3: a great famine in the Shandong commanderies; people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 時金人陷京東諸郡，民聚為盜，至車載乾屍為糧。

translations.literal: At the time the Jurchens had taken the various prefectures of Jingdong; the people gathered as bandits, even loading dried corpses on carts for provisions.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens had overrun the Jingdong prefectures; people banded together as robbers, even hauling dried corpses in carts for food.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，行在、越州及東南諸路郡國飢。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 1: the traveling court, Yue Prefecture, and the commanderies and kingdoms of the southeastern circuits famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 1: famine at the traveling court, Yue Prefecture, and throughout the southeastern circuits.

sentences.zh: 淮南、京東西民流常州、平江府者多殍死。

translations.literal: People of Huainan and Jingdong East and West who drifted to Chang Prefecture and Pingjiang Prefecture mostly died of exposure.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees from Huainan and Jingdong East and West who reached Chang Prefecture and Pingjiang Prefecture mostly died along the way.

sentences.zh: 二年春，兩浙、福建飢，米鬥千錢。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring: the two Zhe circuits and Fujian famine; rice one dou a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 2, spring: famine in the two Zhe circuits and Fujian—rice a thousand cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 時餫餉繁急，民益艱食。

translations.literal: At the time transport levies were urgent and pressing; the people found food ever harder.
translations.idiomatic: Transport levies were urgent, and the people found food ever scarcer.

sentences.zh: 三年，吉、郴、道州、桂陽監飢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Ji, Chen, and Dao prefectures and Guiyang Directorate famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 3: famine at Ji, Chen, and Dao prefectures and Guiyang Directorate.

sentences.zh: 五年，湖南大饑，殍死、流亡者眾。

translations.literal: Year 5: Hunan great famine; many died of exposure and many were displaced.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 5: a great famine in Hunan; vast numbers died or fled.

sentences.zh: 夏，潼川路飢，米鬥二千，人食糟糠。

translations.literal: Summer: Tongchuan circuit famine; rice two thousand cash per dou; people ate chaff and bran.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the Tongchuan circuit suffered famine—rice two thousand cash per dou—and people ate chaff and bran.

sentences.zh: 興元飢，民流於果、閬。

translations.literal: Xingyuan famine; the people drifted to Guo and Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyuan suffered famine, and the people fled toward Guo and Lang.

sentences.zh: 秋，溫、處州飢。

translations.literal: Autumn: Wen and Chu prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn famine struck Wen and Chu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 六年春，浙東、福建飢，湖南、江西大饑，殍死甚眾，民多流徙，郡邑盜起。

translations.literal: Year 6, spring: Zhedong and Fujian famine; Hunan and Jiangxi great famine; very many died of exposure; many people drifted away; bandits rose in prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 6, spring: famine in Zhedong and Fujian; a great famine in Hunan and Jiangxi with countless dead; mass displacement; banditry broke out across the counties.

sentences.zh: 夏，蜀亦大饑，米鬥二千，利路倍之，道殣枕藉。

translations.literal: Summer: Shu also great famine; rice two thousand cash per dou; Lizhou circuit doubled it; corpses on the roads lay piled one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Shu suffered a great famine as well—rice two thousand cash per dou, twice that on the Lizhou circuit—and corpses littered the roads.

sentences.zh: 是歲，果州守臣宇文彬獻《禾粟九穗圖》，吏部侍郎晏敦復言：“果、遂饑民未蘇，不宜導諛。”

translations.literal: That year Guo Prefecture guardian official Yuwen Bin presented the 《Nine-Ear Grain and Millet Painting》; Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel Yan Dunfu said: "The famine people of Guo and Sui have not yet recovered; one ought not lead flattery."
translations.idiomatic: That year Yuwen Bin, prefect of Guo, presented the 《Nine-Ear Grain and Millet Painting》; Yan Dunfu, Vice Minister of Personnel, said, "The famine victims of Guo and Sui have not yet recovered; this is no time to encourage flattery."

sentences.zh: 坐黜爵。

translations.literal: He was demoted in rank by the offense.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Bin was demoted in rank for it.

sentences.zh: 七年夏，欽、廉、邕州飢。

translations.literal: Year 7, summer: Qin, Lian, and Yong prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 7, summer: famine at Qin, Lian, and Yong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九年，江東西、浙東飢，米鬥千錢，饒、信州尤甚。

translations.literal: Year 9: Jiangdong East and West and Zhedong famine; rice one dou a thousand cash; Rao and Xin prefectures especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 9: famine in Jiangdong East and West and Zhedong—rice a thousand cash per dou, worst at Rao and Xin.

sentences.zh: 十年，浙東、江南薦飢，人食草木。

translations.literal: Year 10: Zhedong and Jiangnan famine again; people ate plants and trees.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 10: famine returned to Zhedong and Jiangnan; people ate wild plants.

sentences.zh: 十一年，京西、淮南飢。

translations.literal: Year 11: Jingxi and Huainan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 11: famine in Jingxi and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 十八年冬，浙東、江、淮郡國多飢，紹興尤甚。

translations.literal: Year 18, winter: Zhedong, Jiang, and Huai commanderies and kingdoms mostly famine; Shaoxing especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 18, winter: widespread famine in Zhedong, Jiang, and Huai; Shaoxing Prefecture was hit hardest.

sentences.zh: 民之仰哺於官者二十八萬六千人，不給，乃食糟糠、草木，殍死殆半。

translations.literal: People relying on official feeding numbered two hundred eighty-six thousand; it was not supplied; then they ate chaff and bran and plants and trees; nearly half died of exposure.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred eighty-six thousand people depended on official relief, which failed; they ate chaff, bran, and wild plants, and nearly half perished.

sentences.zh: 十九年春、夏，紹興府大饑，明、婺州亦如之。

translations.literal: Year 19, spring and summer: Shaoxing Prefecture great famine; Ming and Wu prefectures likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 19, spring and summer: a great famine at Shaoxing Prefecture; Ming and Wu prefectures suffered likewise.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，衢州飢。

translations.literal: Year 24: Qu Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 24: famine at Qu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，平江府飢。

translations.literal: Year 28: Pingjiang Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 28: famine at Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，紹興府薦飢。

translations.literal: Year 29: Shaoxing Prefecture famine again.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 29: famine returned to Shaoxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，紹興府大饑，四川尤甚。

translations.literal: Longxing year 1: Shaoxing Prefecture great famine; Sichuan especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing 1: a great famine at Shaoxing Prefecture; Sichuan was worse still.

sentences.zh: 平江、襄陽府、隨、泗州、棗陽、盱眙軍大饑，隨、棗間米鬥六七千。

translations.literal: Pingjiang, Xiangyang Prefecture, Sui, Si, Zaoyang, and Xuyi Army great famine; between Sui and Zao rice six or seven thousand cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang, Xiangyang, Sui, Si, Zaoyang, and Xuyi Army suffered great famine; between Sui and Zao rice sold for six or seven thousand cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 二年，平江府、常、秀州飢，華亭縣人食粃糠。

translations.literal: Year 2: Pingjiang Prefecture, Chang, and Xiu prefectures famine; people of Huating County ate bran and chaff.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing 2: famine at Pingjiang Prefecture and Chang and Xiu; in Huating County people ate bran and chaff.

sentences.zh: 行都及鎮江府、興化軍、台、徽州亦艱食。

translations.literal: The traveling capital and Zhenjiang Prefecture, Xinghua Army, Tai, and Hui prefectures also had hard food.
translations.idiomatic: The traveling capital, Zhenjiang, Xinghua Army, and Tai and Hui prefectures also faced severe food shortages.

sentences.zh: 淮民流徙江南者數十萬。

translations.literal: Huai people who drifted to Jiangnan numbered several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred thousand refugees from the Huai region fled into Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年春，行都、平江、鎮江、紹興府、湖、常、秀州大饑，殍徙者不可勝計。

translations.literal: Qiandao year 1, spring: the traveling capital, Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing Prefecture, Hu, Chang, and Xiu prefectures great famine; those who died of exposure and drifted away were countless.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 1, spring: a great famine at the traveling capital, Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing Prefecture, and Hu, Chang, and Xiu—the dead and displaced were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 是歲，台、明州、江東諸郡皆飢。

translations.literal: That year Tai, Ming Prefecture, and the various commanderies of Jiangdong all famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine struck Tai, Ming Prefecture, and the Jiangdong commanderies.

sentences.zh: 夏，亡麥。

translations.literal: Summer: the wheat crop was lost.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the wheat crop failed.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 2, summer: the wheat crop was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 2, summer: the wheat crop failed again.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，不雨，麥種不入。

translations.literal: Year 3, ninth month: no rain; wheat seed could not be sown.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 3, ninth month: drought prevented the wheat from being sown.

sentences.zh: 四年春，蜀、邛、綿、劍、漢州、石泉軍大饑，邛為甚。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring: Shu, Qiong, Mian, Jian, Han Prefecture, and Shiquan Army great famine; Qiong was most severe.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 4, spring: a great famine in Shu, Qiong, Mian, Jian, Han Prefecture, and Shiquan Army—Qiong worst of all.

sentences.zh: 盜延八郡，漢饑民至九萬餘。

translations.literal: Bandits spread through eight prefectures; Han famine people reached more than ninety thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Banditry spread across eight prefectures; famine refugees in Han Prefecture alone exceeded ninety thousand.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，饒、信州薦飢，民多流徙。

translations.literal: Year 5, summer: Rao and Xin prefectures famine again; many people drifted away.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 5, summer: famine returned to Rao and Xin; mass displacement followed.

sentences.zh: 徽州大饑，人食蕨葛。

translations.literal: Huizhou great famine; people ate bracken and kudzu.
translations.idiomatic: A great famine at Huizhou drove people to eat bracken and kudzu.

sentences.zh: 台、楚州、盱眙軍亦飢。

translations.literal: Tai, Chu Prefecture, and Xuyi Army also famine.
translations.idiomatic: Tai, Chu Prefecture, and Xuyi Army also suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 秋冬不雨，淮郡麥種不入。

translations.literal: Autumn and winter without rain; Huai commanderies' wheat seed could not be sown.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn and winter brought no rain, and the Huai prefectures could not sow their wheat.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，寧國府、廣德軍、太平、湖、秀、池、徽、和州皆飢。

translations.literal: Year 6, winter: Ningguo Prefecture, Guangde Army, Taiping, Hu, Xiu, Chi, Hui, and He prefectures all famine.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 6, winter: famine at Ningguo Prefecture, Guangde Army, and Taiping, Hu, Xiu, Chi, Hui, and He.

sentences.zh: 七年秋，江東西、湖南十餘郡飢，江、筠州、隆興府為甚。

translations.literal: Year 7, autumn: Jiangdong East and West and Hunan more than ten commanderies famine; Jiang, Jun Prefecture, and Longxing Prefecture most severe.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 7, autumn: famine in more than ten commanderies of Jiangdong East and West and Hunan—worst at Jiang, Jun Prefecture, and Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 人食草實，流徙淮甸，詔出內帑收育棄孩。

translations.literal: People ate grass seeds; they drifted to the Huai region; an edict ordered disbursement from the inner treasury to take in and rear abandoned infants.
translations.idiomatic: People ate wild seeds and fled to the Huai region; an edict ordered funds from the inner treasury to rescue abandoned children.

sentences.zh: 淮郡亦薦飢，金人運麥於淮北岸易南岸銅鏹，鬥錢八千。

translations.literal: Huai commanderies also famine again; Jurchens transported wheat to the north bank of the Huai to exchange for south-bank copper cash; eight thousand cash per dou.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai prefectures suffered famine again; Jurchens ferried wheat to the north bank to trade for copper cash on the south bank at eight thousand cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 江西飢，民流光、濠、安豐間，皆效淮人私糴，錢為之耗。

translations.literal: Jiangxi famine; the people drifted among Guang, Hao, and Anfeng; all imitated Huai people in private grain purchases; cash was depleted thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi suffered famine; refugees scattered among Guang, Hao, and Anfeng, buying grain privately as the Huai people did, draining the currency.

sentences.zh: 荊南亦飢。

translations.literal: Jingnan also famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jingnan suffered famine as well.

sentences.zh: 八年，江西亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 8: Jiangxi lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 8: the wheat crop failed in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 隆興府薦飢，南昌、新建縣饑民仰給者二八千餘。

translations.literal: Longxing Prefecture famine again; famine people of Nanchang and Xinjian counties relying on official provision numbered more than twenty-eight thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Famine returned to Longxing Prefecture; more than twenty-eight thousand people in Nanchang and Xinjian counties depended on official relief.

sentences.zh: 九年春，成都、永康、邛三州飢。

translations.literal: Year 9, spring: Chengdu, Yongkang, and Qiong three prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 9, spring: famine at Chengdu, Yongkang, and Qiong.

sentences.zh: 秋，台州飢，溫、婺州亦飢。

translations.literal: Autumn: Tai Prefecture famine; Wen and Wu prefectures also famine.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn famine struck Tai Prefecture, Wen, and Wu.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，浙東、湖南、廣西、江西、蜀關外皆飢，台、處、郴、桂、昭、賀尤甚。

translations.literal: Chunxi year 1: Zhedong, Hunan, Guangxi, Jiangxi, and Shu beyond the passes all famine; Tai, Chu, Chen, Gui, Zhao, and He especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 1: famine throughout Zhedong, Hunan, Guangxi, Jiangxi, and Shu beyond the passes—worst at Tai, Chu, Chen, Gui, Zhao, and He.

sentences.zh: 二年，淮東西、江東飢，滁、真、揚州、盱眙軍、建康府為甚。

translations.literal: Year 2: Huai East and West and Jiangdong famine; Chu, Zhen, Yang Prefecture, Xuyi Army, and Jiankang Prefecture most severe.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 2: famine in Huai East and West and Jiangdong—worst at Chu, Zhen, Yang Prefecture, Xuyi Army, and Jiankang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是歲，鎮江、寧國府、常州、廣德軍亦艱食。

translations.literal: That year Zhenjiang, Ningguo Prefecture, Chang Prefecture, and Guangde Army also had hard food.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhenjiang, Ningguo Prefecture, Chang, and Guangde Army also faced severe food shortages.

sentences.zh: 詔獎建康留守劉珙振濟有方。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded Jiankang garrison commander Liu Gong for skillful relief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended Liu Gong, garrison commander of Jiankang, for effective famine relief.

sentences.zh: 三年，淮甸飢。

translations.literal: Year 3: the Huai region famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 3: famine in the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 夏，台州亡麥。

translations.literal: Summer: Tai Prefecture lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the wheat crop failed at Tai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬，复、施、隨、郢州、荊門軍、襄陽、江陵、德安府大饑；

translations.literal: Winter: Fu, Shi, Sui, Ying Prefecture, Jingmen Army, Xiangyang, Jiangling, and De'an Prefecture great famine;
translations.idiomatic: That winter a great famine gripped Fu, Shi, Sui, Ying Prefecture, Jingmen Army, Xiangyang, Jiangling, and De'an Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 四年春，尤飢。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring: especially severe famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 4, spring: famine was especially severe.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，和州飢。

translations.literal: Year 6, winter: He Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 6, winter: famine at He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 泰、通、楚州、高郵軍大饑，人食草木。

translations.literal: Tai, Tong, Chu Prefecture, and Gaoyou Army great famine; people ate plants and trees.
translations.idiomatic: A great famine at Tai, Tong, Chu Prefecture, and Gaoyou Army drove people to eat wild plants.

sentences.zh: 七年，鎮江府、台州、無為、廣德軍民大饑。

translations.literal: Year 7: Zhenjiang Prefecture, Tai Prefecture, Wuwei, and Guangde Army people great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 7: the people of Zhenjiang Prefecture, Tai Prefecture, Wuwei, and Guangde Army suffered great famine.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、浙、荊、湘、淮郡皆飢。

translations.literal: That year Jiang, Zhe, Jing, Xiang, and Huai commanderies all famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine struck the Jiang, Zhe, Jing, Xiang, and Huai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八年春，江州飢，人采葛而食，詔罷守臣章騂。

translations.literal: Year 8, spring: Jiang Prefecture famine; people gathered kudzu to eat; an edict dismissed guardian official Zhang Xian.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 8, spring: famine at Jiang Prefecture; people gathered kudzu to eat; an edict dismissed the prefect Zhang Xian.

sentences.zh: 冬，行都、寧國、建康府、嚴、婺、太平州、廣德軍飢，徽、饒州大饑，流淮郡者萬餘人，浙東常平使者朱熹進對論荒政，請蠲田賦、身丁錢，詔江、浙、淮、湖北三十八郡並免之。

translations.literal: Winter: the traveling capital, Ningguo, Jiankang Prefecture, Yan, Wu, Taiping Prefecture, and Guangde Army famine; Hui and Rao prefectures great famine; more than ten thousand who drifted to Huai commanderies; Zhedong Ever-Normal envoy Zhu Xi entered audience to discuss famine policy, requesting remission of field tax and corvée cash; an edict ordered thirty-eight commanderies of Jiang, Zhe, Huai, and Hubei all exempted.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the traveling capital, Ningguo, Jiankang, Yan, Wu, Taiping, and Guangde Army suffered famine; Hui and Rao were hit by great famine; more than ten thousand refugees reached the Huai prefectures; Zhu Xi, Ever-Normal commissioner for Zhedong, memorialized on famine relief and asked to remit field taxes and poll taxes; an edict exempted thirty-eight commanderies in Jiang, Zhe, Huai, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 九年春，大亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 9, spring: the wheat crop was largely lost.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 9, spring: the wheat crop largely failed.

sentences.zh: 行都飢，於潛、昌化縣人食草木。

translations.literal: The traveling capital famine; people of Yuqian and Changhua counties ate plants and trees.
translations.idiomatic: The traveling capital suffered famine; in Yuqian and Changhua counties people ate wild plants.

sentences.zh: 紹興府、衢、婺、嚴、明、台、湖州飢。

translations.literal: Shaoxing Prefecture, Qu, Wu, Yan, Ming, Tai, and Hu prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine at Shaoxing Prefecture, Qu, Wu, Yan, Ming, Tai, and Hu.

sentences.zh: 徽州大饑，穜稑亦絕。

translations.literal: Huizhou great famine; early and late rice were both exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: A great famine at Huizhou exhausted both early and late rice crops.

sentences.zh: 湖北七郡薦飢。

translations.literal: Seven commanderies of Hubei famine again.
translations.idiomatic: Famine returned to seven commanderies in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 蜀潼、利、夔三路郡國十八皆飢，流徙者數千人。

translations.literal: Shu Tong, Li, and Kui three circuits—eighteen commanderies and kingdoms all famine; those who drifted away numbered several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In Shu, eighteen commanderies in the Tong, Li, and Kui circuits suffered famine; several thousand people were displaced.

sentences.zh: 十年，合、昌州薦飢，民就振相蹂死者三千餘人。

translations.literal: Year 10: He and Chang prefectures famine again; more than three thousand died trampled while rushing relief.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 10: famine returned to He and Chang; more than three thousand died in the crush at relief distribution.

sentences.zh: 十一年，泉、汀、漳州、興化軍亡禾。

translations.literal: Year 11: Quan, Ting, and Zhang prefectures and Xinghua Army lost their grain crop.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 11: Quan, Ting, and Zhang prefectures and Xinghua Army lost their grain harvest.

sentences.zh: 邕、賓、象州飢。

translations.literal: Yong, Bin, and Xiang prefectures famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine at Yong, Bin, and Xiang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二年，福建飢，亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 12: Fujian famine; wheat crop lost.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 12: famine in Fujian; the wheat crop failed.

sentences.zh: 江西、廣東西飢。

translations.literal: Jiangxi and Guangdong West famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Jiangxi and western Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 金州飢，有流徙者。

translations.literal: Jin Prefecture famine; there were displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Prefecture suffered famine, and people were displaced.

sentences.zh: 十四年，金、洋、階、成、鳳、西和州人乏食。

translations.literal: Year 14: Jin, Yang, Jie, Cheng, Feng, and Xihe prefectures—people lacked grain.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 14: people lacked food in Jin, Yang, Jie, Cheng, Feng, and Xihe prefectures.

sentences.zh: 七月，秀州飢，有流徙者。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Xiu Prefecture famine; there were displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: famine at Xiu Prefecture; people were displaced.

sentences.zh: 臨安府九縣飢。

translations.literal: Nine counties of Lin'an Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Nine counties of Lin'an Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十六年夏，成州亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 16, summer: Cheng Prefecture lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 16, summer: the wheat crop failed at Cheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬，際、成、鳳、西和州薦飢。

translations.literal: Winter: Ji, Cheng, Feng, and Xihe prefectures famine again.
translations.idiomatic: That winter famine returned to Ji, Cheng, Feng, and Xihe prefectures.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，蘄州飢。

translations.literal: Shaoxi year 2: Qi Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 2: famine at Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夔路五郡飢，渝、涪為甚。

translations.literal: Five commanderies of the Kui circuit famine; Yu and Fu most severe.
translations.idiomatic: Five commanderies in the Kui circuit suffered famine—worst at Yu and Fu.

sentences.zh: 階、成、鳳、西和州亡麥。

translations.literal: Jie, Cheng, Feng, and Xihe prefectures lost their wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: The wheat crop failed in Jie, Cheng, Feng, and Xihe prefectures.

sentences.zh: 三年，資、榮州亡麥，普、敘、簡、隆州、富順監皆大饑，亡麥，殍死者眾，民流成都府至千餘人，威遠縣棄兒且六百人。

translations.literal: Year 3: Zi and Rong prefectures lost their wheat crop; Pu, Xu, Jian, Long prefectures and Fushun Directorate all great famine, wheat lost, many died of exposure; people drifting to Chengdu Prefecture reached more than a thousand; Weiyuan County abandoned infants numbered nearly six hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 3: the wheat crop failed at Zi and Rong; Pu, Xu, Jian, Long, and Fushun Directorate suffered great famine with mass death; more than a thousand refugees reached Chengdu; nearly six hundred infants were abandoned in Weiyuan County.

sentences.zh: 揚州亦多飢。

translations.literal: Yang Prefecture also had much famine.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Prefecture also suffered widespread famine.

sentences.zh: 四年，簡、資、普州飢，綿州亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 4: Jian, Zi, and Pu prefectures famine; Mian Prefecture lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 4: famine at Jian, Zi, and Pu; the wheat crop failed at Mian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏，紹興府亡麥。

translations.literal: Summer: Shaoxing Prefecture lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the wheat crop failed at Shaoxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 安豐軍大亡麥。

translations.literal: Anfeng Army largely lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Anfeng Army largely lost its wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，亡麥苗。

translations.literal: Year 5, winter: wheat seedlings lost.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 5, winter: the wheat seedlings perished.

sentences.zh: 行都、淮、浙西東、江東郡國皆飢，常、明州、寧國、鎮江府、廬滁、和州為甚，人食草木。

translations.literal: The traveling capital, Huai, Zhe West and East, and Jiangdong commanderies and kingdoms all famine; Chang, Ming Prefecture, Ningguo, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Lu, Chu, and He most severe; people ate plants and trees.
translations.idiomatic: Famine gripped the traveling capital, Huai, western and eastern Zhe, and Jiangdong—worst at Chang, Ming, Ningguo, Zhenjiang, Lu, Chu, and He; people ate wild plants.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年春，常州飢，民之死徙者眾。

translations.literal: Qingyuan year 1, spring: Chang Prefecture famine; many among the people died or fled.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 1, spring: famine at Chang Prefecture; many people died or were displaced.

sentences.zh: 楚州飢，人食糟粕。

translations.literal: Chu Prefecture famine; people ate chaff and dregs.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Prefecture suffered famine, and people ate chaff and dregs.

sentences.zh: 淮、浙民流行都。

translations.literal: People from Huai and Zhe fled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: People from Huai and Zhe streamed into the capital.

sentences.zh: 三年，浙東郡國亡麥，台州大亡麥，民飢多殍。

translations.literal: Year 3: eastern Zhe commanderies and kingdoms lost their wheat; Taizhou largely lost its wheat; the people famine-stricken, many died of exposure.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 3: eastern Zhe lost its wheat crop; Taizhou lost most of its wheat; famine left many dead in the streets.

sentences.zh: 襄、蜀亦飢。

translations.literal: Xiang and Shu also famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang and Shu also suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 四年秋，浙東西薦飢，多道殣。

translations.literal: Year 4, autumn: eastern and western Zhe famine again; many corpses lined the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 4, autumn: famine returned to eastern and western Zhe; corpses littered the roads.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，常州大饑，仰哺者六十萬人。

translations.literal: Year 6, winter: Chang Prefecture great famine; six hundred thousand people relied on official feeding.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 6, winter: a great famine at Chang Prefecture; six hundred thousand people depended on official relief.

sentences.zh: 潤、揚、楚、通、泰州、建康府、江陰軍亦乏食。

translations.literal: Run, Yang, Chu, Tong, and Taizhou, Jiankang Prefecture, and Jiangyin Army also lacked food.
translations.idiomatic: Run, Yang, Chu, Tong, and Taizhou, Jiankang Prefecture, and Jiangyin Army also ran short of food.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年，浙西郡國薦飢，常州、鎮江、嘉興府為甚。

translations.literal: Jiatai year 1: western Zhe commanderies and kingdoms famine again; Chang Prefecture, Zhenjiang, and Jiaxing Prefecture most severe.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 1: famine returned to western Zhe—worst at Chang, Zhenjiang, and Jiaxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年，四川飢，廣安、懷安軍、潼川府大亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 2: Sichuan famine; Guang'an and Huai'an armies and Tongchuan Prefecture largely lost their wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 2: famine in Sichuan; Guang'an and Huai'an armies and Tongchuan Prefecture largely lost their wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 衡、郴州、武岡、桂陽軍乏食。

translations.literal: Heng and Chen prefectures, Wugang, and Guiyang Army lacked grain.
translations.idiomatic: Heng and Chen prefectures, Wugang, and Guiyang Army lacked food.

sentences.zh: 三年春，邵、永州大饑，死徙者眾，民多剽盜。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring: Shao and Yong prefectures great famine; many died or fled; people widely turned to plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 3, spring: a great famine at Shao and Yong; mass death and flight; widespread banditry.

sentences.zh: 夏，行都艱食。

translations.literal: Summer: the traveling capital had hard food.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the traveling capital faced severe food shortages.

sentences.zh: 四年春，撫、袁州、隆興府、臨江軍大饑，殍死者不可勝瘞，有舉家二十七人同赴水死者。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring: Fu and Yuan prefectures, Longxing Prefecture, and Linjiang Army great famine; the dead of exposure could not all be buried; one household of twenty-seven together drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 4, spring: a great famine at Fu and Yuan, Longxing Prefecture, and Linjiang Army—the unburied dead were beyond count; one family of twenty-seven drowned together.

sentences.zh: 開禧二年，紹興府、衢、婺州亡麥。

translations.literal: Kaixi year 2: Shaoxing Prefecture, Qu, and Wu prefectures lost their wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Kaixi 2: the wheat crop failed at Shaoxing Prefecture and Qu and Wu.

sentences.zh: 湖北、京西、淮東西郡國飢，民聚為剽盜。

translations.literal: Hubei, Jingxi, and Huai East and West commanderies and kingdoms famine; the people gathered as plundering bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Famine in Hubei, Jingxi, and Huai East and West; people formed plundering bands.

sentences.zh: 南康軍、忠、涪州皆飢。

translations.literal: Nankang Army, Zhong, and Fu prefectures all famine.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang Army and Zhong and Fu prefectures all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年，淮民大饑，食草木，流於江、浙者百萬人。

translations.literal: Jiading year 1: Huai people great famine, ate plants and trees; those who drifted to Jiang and Zhe numbered a million.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 1: the Huai people suffered great famine, ate wild plants, and a million refugees fled into Jiang and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 先是淮郡罷兵，農久失業，米鬥二千，殍死者十三四，炮人肉、馬矢食之。

translations.literal: Earlier the Huai commanderies had demobilized troops; farming had long been neglected; rice two thousand cash per dou; thirteen or fourteen in ten died of exposure; they roasted human flesh and ate horse dung.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai prefectures had stood down their troops and farming had long collapsed; rice reached two thousand cash per dou; thirteen or fourteen in ten perished; people roasted human flesh and ate horse dung.

sentences.zh: 詔所至郡國振卹歸業，時邦儲既匱，郡計不支，去者多死，亦有俘掠而北者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered every commandery and kingdom reached to relieve and return people to their livelihoods; at the time state stores were exhausted and commandery budgets could not sustain it; most who left died, and some were captured and taken north.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered local governments to provide relief and restore livelihoods, but state stores were empty and county budgets failed; most refugees died, and some were seized and taken north.

sentences.zh: 是歲，行都亦飢，米鬥千錢。

translations.literal: That year the traveling capital also famine; rice one dou a thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: That year the traveling capital suffered famine—rice a thousand cash per dou.

sentences.zh: 二年春，兩淮、荊、襄、建康府大饑，米鬥錢數千，人食草木。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring: the two Huai circuits, Jing, Xiang, and Jiankang Prefecture great famine; rice several thousand cash per dou; people ate plants and trees.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 2, spring: a great famine in the two Huai circuits, Jing, Xiang, and Jiankang—rice several thousand cash per dou; people ate wild plants.

sentences.zh: 淮民刲道殣食盡，發瘞胔繼之，人相搤噬。

translations.literal: Huai people cut flesh from corpses on the roads until none remained, then opened burial mounds for the rotting dead; people seized and devoured one another.
translations.idiomatic: Huai refugees stripped corpses on the roads, then opened graves for rotting remains; people fought one another for food.

sentences.zh: 流於揚州者數千家，度江者聚建康，殍死日八九十人。

translations.literal: Those who drifted to Yang Prefecture numbered several thousand households; those who crossed the river gathered at Jiankang; eighty or ninety died of exposure each day.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand households reached Yang Prefecture; refugees who crossed the Yang gathered at Jiankang, where eighty or ninety died each day.

sentences.zh: 是秋，諸路復大歉，常、潤尤甚。

translations.literal: That autumn the various circuits again had great dearth; Chang and Run especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn harvests failed again across the circuits—worst at Chang and Run.

sentences.zh: 冬，行都大饑，殍者橫市，道多棄兒。

translations.literal: Winter: the traveling capital great famine; the exposed dead filled the markets; many abandoned infants lay on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: That winter a great famine at the traveling capital left the markets strewn with corpses and the roads with abandoned infants.

sentences.zh: 三年春，建康府大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring: Jiankang Prefecture great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 3, spring: a great famine at Jiankang; people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 五月，衢州飢，頗聚為剽盜。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Qu Prefecture famine; many gathered as plundering bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: famine at Qu Prefecture; widespread banditry.

sentences.zh: 七年，台州大亡麥。

translations.literal: Year 7: Tai Prefecture largely lost its wheat crop.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 7: the wheat crop largely failed at Tai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八年，淮、浙、江東西飢，都昌縣為盜者三十六黨。

translations.literal: Year 8: Huai, Zhe, and Jiangdong East and West famine; in Duchang County thirty-six bandit bands.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 8: famine in Huai, Zhe, and Jiangdong East and West; thirty-six bandit bands in Duchang County.

sentences.zh: 九年，行都飢，閭巷有殍。

translations.literal: Year 9: the traveling capital famine; corpses lay in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 9: famine at the traveling capital; corpses in the alleys.

sentences.zh: 十年，台、衢、婺、饒、信州飢，剽盜起，台為甚。

translations.literal: Year 10: Tai, Qu, Wu, Rao, and Xin prefectures famine; plundering bandits rose; Tai most severe.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 10: famine at Tai, Qu, Wu, Rao, and Xin; banditry broke out—worst at Tai.

sentences.zh: 蜀石泉軍飢，殍死殆萬餘人。

translations.literal: Shi Spring Army in Shu famine; nearly ten thousand died of exposure.
translations.idiomatic: Shiquan Army in Shu suffered famine; nearly ten thousand perished.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，淮、浙、江東饑饉，亡麥苗。

translations.literal: Year 11, autumn: Huai, Zhe, and Jiangdong dearth and famine; wheat seedlings lost.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 11, autumn: dearth in Huai, Zhe, and Jiangdong; wheat seedlings perished.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，潼川府飢而不害。

translations.literal: Year 12, spring: Tongchuan Prefecture famine but without harm.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 12, spring: Tongchuan Prefecture had famine but crops were not destroyed.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，福州飢，人食草根。

translations.literal: Year 13, spring: Fuzhou famine; people ate grass roots.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 13, spring: famine at Fuzhou; people ate grass roots.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，海州新附山東民飢，京東、河北路新附山西民亦飢。

translations.literal: Year 16, spring: newly submitted Shandong people of Haizhou famine; newly submitted Shanxi people of Jingdong and Hebei circuits also famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 16, spring: newly submitted Shandong people at Haizhou suffered famine; newly submitted Shanxi people in Jingdong and Hebei also suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 湖南永、道州大饑。

translations.literal: Yong and Dao prefectures in Hunan great famine.
translations.idiomatic: A great famine in Yong and Dao prefectures, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 是歲，行都、江、淮、閩、浙郡國皆亡麥禾。

translations.literal: That year the traveling capital and Jiang, Huai, Min, and Zhe commanderies and kingdoms all lost wheat and grain.
translations.idiomatic: That year the traveling capital and Jiang, Huai, Min, and Zhe lost their wheat and grain harvests.

sentences.zh: 十七年春，餘杭、錢塘、仁和三縣飢，鎮江府飢，真、鄂州亦乏食。

translations.literal: Year 17, spring: Yuhang, Qiantang, and Renhe three counties famine; Zhenjiang Prefecture famine; Zhen and E prefectures also lacked grain.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 17, spring: famine in Yuhang, Qiantang, and Renhe; Zhenjiang Prefecture famine; Zhen and E also lacked food.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年，紹興府薦飢，臨安府大饑，嚴州飢。

translations.literal: Jiaxi year 4: Shaoxing Prefecture famine again; Lin'an Prefecture great famine; Yan Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxi 4: famine returned to Shaoxing Prefecture; great famine at Lin'an; famine at Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸淳七年，江南大饑。

translations.literal: Xianchun year 7: Jiangnan great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 7: a great famine in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 八年冬，襄陽飢，人相食。

translations.literal: Year 8, winter: Xiangyang famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 8, winter: famine at Xiangyang; cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 德祐二年正月，揚州飢。

translations.literal: Deyou year 2, first month: Yang Prefecture famine.
translations.idiomatic: Deyou 2, first month: famine at Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月，揚州穀價騰踴，民相食。

translations.literal: Third month: grain prices at Yang soared; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: grain prices at Yang soared; people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年五月，揚州暴風，壞軍營舍僅百區。

translations.literal: Qiande year 2, fifth month: Yangzhou violent wind damaged nearly a hundred sections of army barracks.
translations.idiomatic: Qiande 2, fifth month: a violent wind at Yangzhou wrecked nearly a hundred army barracks.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，揚州暴風，壞軍營舍及城上敵棚。

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month: Yangzhou violent wind damaged army barracks and enemy towers on the wall.
translations.idiomatic: Qiande 3, sixth month: a violent wind at Yangzhou damaged barracks and wall towers.

sentences.zh: 開寶二年三月，帝駐太原城下，大風，一夕而止。

translations.literal: Kaibao year 2, third month: the Emperor was encamped below Taiyuan city; a great wind; it stopped after one night.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 2, third month: the emperor encamped below Taiyuan; a great wind blew one night and ceased.

sentences.zh: 八年十月，廣州颶風起，一晝夜，雨水二丈餘，海為之漲，飄失舟楫。

translations.literal: Year 8, tenth month: a hurricane rose at Guangzhou; for one day and night rain and water more than twenty chi; the sea swelled and boats were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 8, tenth month: a hurricane at Guangzhou; rain and floodwaters rose more than twenty chi in a day and night; the sea surged and vessels were lost.

sentences.zh: 九年四月，宋州大風，壞甲仗庫、城樓、軍營凡四千五百九十六區。

translations.literal: Year 9, fourth month: a great wind at Song Prefecture damaged the armory, gate towers, and barracks—four thousand four hundred ninety-six sections in all.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao 9, fourth month: a great wind at Song Prefecture damaged the armory, gate towers, and barracks—4,496 sections in all.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年六月，曹州大風，壞濟陰縣廨及軍營。

translations.literal: Taiping Xingguo year 2, sixth month: a great wind at Cao Prefecture damaged the Jiyin county yamen and barracks.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 2, sixth month: a great wind at Cao Prefecture damaged the Jiyin county seat and barracks.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，泗州大風，浮梁竹笮、鐵索斷，華表石柱折。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month: a great wind at Si Prefecture broke the floating bridge bamboo cables and iron chains; ornamental columns and stone pillars snapped.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 4, eighth month: a great wind at Si Prefecture broke floating-bridge cables and chains and snapped stone pillars.

sentences.zh: 六年九月，高州大風雨，壞廨宇及民舍五百區。

translations.literal: Year 6, ninth month: great wind and rain at Gao Prefecture damaged yamen and five hundred sections of commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 6, ninth month: wind and rain at Gao Prefecture damaged government offices and five hundred houses.

sentences.zh: 七年八月，瓊州颶風，壞城門、州署、民舍殆盡。

translations.literal: Year 7, eighth month: hurricane at Qiong Prefecture destroyed city gates, the prefectural compound, and nearly all commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 7, eighth month: a hurricane at Qiong Prefecture destroyed the gates, the prefectural compound, and nearly all houses.

sentences.zh: 八年九月，太平軍颶風拔木，壞廨宇、民舍千八十七區。

translations.literal: Year 8, ninth month: hurricane at Taiping Army uprooted trees and damaged yamen and 1,087 sections of commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 8, ninth month: a hurricane at Taiping Army uprooted trees and damaged offices and 1,087 houses.

sentences.zh: 十月，雷州颶風壞禀庫、民舍七百區。

translations.literal: Tenth month: hurricane at Lei Prefecture damaged granaries and seven hundred sections of commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: a hurricane at Lei Prefecture damaged granaries and seven hundred houses.

sentences.zh: 九年八月，白州颶風，壞廨宇、民舍。

translations.literal: Year 9, eighth month: hurricane at Bai Prefecture damaged yamen and commoners' houses.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Xingguo 9, eighth month: a hurricane at Bai Prefecture damaged government offices and houses.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，京師暴風起東北，塵沙曀日，人不相辨。

translations.literal: Duangong year 2: a violent wind rose in the northeast of the capital; dust and sand darkened the sun; people could not recognize one another.
translations.idiomatic: Duangong 2: a violent wind from the northeast of the capital darkened the sun with dust; people could not see one another.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年五月，通利軍大風害稼。

translations.literal: Chunhua year 2, fifth month: a great wind at Tongli Army harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 2, fifth month: a great wind at Tongli Army destroyed crops.

sentences.zh: 三年六月丁丑，黑風自西北起，天地晦暝，雷震，有頃乃止。

translations.literal: In the third year, sixth month, day dingchou: black wind rose from the northwest; heaven and earth were dim; thunder sounded; after a while it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 3, sixth month, day dingchou: black wind rose from the northwest, the sky went dark, thunder rolled, then it ceased.

sentences.zh: 先是京師大熱，疫死者眾，及北風至，疫疾遂止。

translations.literal: Earlier the capital had been intensely hot; many died of epidemic; when the north wind came, the epidemic then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The capital had been fiercely hot and epidemic deaths were many; when the north wind came, the epidemic abated.

sentences.zh: 至道二年八月，潮州颶風，壞州廨、營砦。

translations.literal: Zhidao year 2, eighth month: hurricane at Chaozhou damaged the prefectural compound and camps.
translations.idiomatic: Zhidao 2, eighth month: a hurricane at Chaozhou damaged the prefectural compound and camps.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年八月，涪州大風，壞城舍。

translations.literal: Xianping year 1, eighth month: a great wind at Fu Prefecture damaged city buildings.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 1, eighth month: a great wind at Fu Prefecture damaged city buildings.

sentences.zh: 四年八月丙子，京師暴風。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, day bingzi: violent wind in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 4, eighth month, day bingzi: a violent wind in the capital.

sentences.zh: 景德二年六月甲午，大風吹沙折木。

translations.literal: Jingde year 2, sixth month, day jiawu: a great wind blew sand and snapped trees.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 2, sixth month, day jiawu: a great wind blew sand and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 八月，福州海上有颶風，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: Eighth month: on the sea off Fuzhou a hurricane damaged houses.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: a hurricane off Fuzhou damaged houses.

sentences.zh: 三年七月丙寅，京師大風。

translations.literal: Year 3, seventh month, day bingyin: a great wind in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 3, seventh month, day bingyin: a great wind in the capital.

sentences.zh: 四年三月甲寅夕，京師大風，黃塵蔽天，自大名歷京畿，害桑稼，唐州尤甚。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, on the evening of day jiayin: a great wind in the capital; yellow dust veiled the sky; from Daming through the capital region it harmed mulberry and grain; Tang Prefecture especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 4, third month, evening of day jiayin: a great wind in the capital veiled the sky in yellow dust; from Daming through the capital it ruined mulberry and grain—worst at Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年四月乙未，大風起京師西北，連日不止。

translations.literal: Dazhong Xiangfu year 2, fourth month, day yiwei: a great wind rose northwest of the capital and did not stop for successive days.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 2, fourth month, day yiwei: a great wind rose northwest of the capital and blew for days without stopping.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，京師大風。

translations.literal: Year 5, eighth month: a great wind in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 5, eighth month: a great wind in the capital.

sentences.zh: 七年三月戊辰，京師大風，揚沙礫。

translations.literal: Year 7, third month, day wuchen: a great wind in the capital; sand and gravel flew.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 7, third month, day wuchen: a great wind in the capital drove sand and gravel.

sentences.zh: 是日，百官習儀恭謝壇，有陷僕者。

translations.literal: That day the hundred officials rehearsed rites at the Altar of Grateful Acknowledgment; some attendants fell.
translations.idiomatic: That day officials rehearsed rites at the Grateful Acknowledgment Altar; some attendants were blown down.

sentences.zh: 八年六月辛亥，京師風起巳位，吹沙揚塵。

translations.literal: Year 8, sixth month, day xinhai: wind rose in the capital from the si position; it blew sand and raised dust.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 8, sixth month, day xinhai: wind rose in the capital from the si quarter and drove sand and dust.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年正月，永州大風，髮屋拔木，數日止。

translations.literal: Tianxi year 2, first month: a great wind at Yong Prefecture tore off roofs and uprooted trees; it stopped after several days.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 2, first month: a great wind at Yong Prefecture tore off roofs and uprooted trees; it lasted several days.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，徐州利國監大風起西南，壞廬舍二百餘區，壓死十二人。

translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month: at Liguo Superintendency in Xu Prefecture a great wind rose from the southwest; it damaged more than two hundred dwellings and crushed twelve people to death.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 3, fifth month: a great wind from the southwest at Liguo Superintendency in Xu Prefecture wrecked more than two hundred houses and killed twelve people.

sentences.zh: 四年四月丁亥，大風起西北，飛沙折木，晝晦數刻。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, fourth month, day dinghai: a great wind rose from the northwest; sand flew and trees broke; daytime was dark for several quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 4, fourth month, day dinghai: a great wind from the northwest drove sand and snapped trees; daylight failed for several quarters.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，暴風起西北，有聲，折木吹沙，黃塵蔽天，佔並主陰謀奸邪。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao: a violent wind rose from the northwest with sound; it broke trees and blew sand; yellow dust veiled the sky; divinations together indicated secret plots and wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, day yimao: a violent northwest wind roared, snapping trees and driving sand until yellow dust filled the sky; omen-readers took it as a sign of conspiracy and treachery.

sentences.zh: 是秋，內侍周懷政坐妖亂伏誅。

translations.literal: That autumn the eunuch Zhou Huaizheng was executed on account of sorcerous rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the eunuch Zhou Huaizheng was put to death for sorcerous sedition.

sentences.zh: 天聖九年十二月辛酉，大風三日止。

translations.literal: Tiansheng year 9, twelfth month, day xinyou: a great wind; it stopped after three days.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng 9, twelfth month, day xinyou: a great wind blew for three days.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年六月己巳，無錫縣大風髮屋，民被壓死者眾。

translations.literal: Jingyou year 1, sixth month, day yisi: at Wuxi County a great wind tore off roofs; many commoners were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou 1, sixth month, day yisi: a great wind at Wuxi County tore off roofs and killed many people under the rubble.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅夜漏上，風自醜起有聲，擺木鳴條。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin, at the first watch of the night wind rose from the chou quarter with sound; it swayed trees and made branches cry out.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, day jiayin, during the first watch wind rose from the chou quarter with a roar, shaking trees until the branches whistled.

sentences.zh: 二年六月戊寅平明，風自未來，佔者以為百穀豐衍之候。

translations.literal: Year 2, sixth month, day wuyin at daybreak wind came from the wei quarter; diviners regarded it as a sign of abundant grain.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou 2, sixth month, day wuyin at daybreak wind came from the wei quarter; diviners read it as a portent of abundant harvests.

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年七月丁巳，大風起西北方，拔木。

translations.literal: Huangyou year 4, seventh month, day dingsi: a great wind rose from the northwest; it uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Huangyou 4, seventh month, day dingsi: a great wind from the northwest uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐二年正月元日平旦，有風從東北來，遍天有蒼黑雲，占云：“大熟多雨。”

translations.literal: Jiayou year 2, first month, New Year's Day at daybreak wind came from the northeast; dark bluish-black clouds covered the sky; divination said: "Great harvest, much rain."
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 2, New Year's Day at daybreak wind came from the northeast beneath dark bluish-black clouds; the omen read: "Great harvest, much rain."

sentences.zh: 熙寧四年二月辛巳，京東自濮州至河北旁邊，大風異常，百姓驚恐，六年四月，館陶縣黑風。

translations.literal: Xining year 4, second month, day xinsi: east of the capital from Puzhou to the Hebei borderlands an extraordinarily abnormal great wind; the common people were terrified. Year 6, fourth month: black wind at Guantao County.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 4, second month, day xinsi: from Puzhou to the Hebei frontier in eastern Jingdong an unnaturally violent great wind terrified the people. Xining 6, fourth month: black wind at Guantao County.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月，海陽潮陽二縣颶風、潮，害民居田稼。

translations.literal: Year 9, eleventh month: hurricane and tidal surge at Haiyang and Chaoyang counties; they harmed commoners' dwellings and field crops.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 9, eleventh month: hurricane and tidal surge at Haiyang and Chaoyang counties damaged houses and crops.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，武城縣大風，壞縣廨，知縣李愈妻、主簿寇宗奭妻之母壓死。

translations.literal: Year 10, sixth month: a great wind at Wucheng County damaged the county yamen; the wife of Magistrate Li Yu and the mother of Registrar Kou Zongshi's wife were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 10, sixth month: a great wind at Wucheng County wrecked the county offices; Magistrate Li Yu's wife and the mother of Registrar Kou Zongshi's wife were killed.

sentences.zh: 七月，溫州大風雨，漂城樓、官舍。

translations.literal: Seventh month: great wind and rain at Wen Prefecture; it floated away city towers and government buildings.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a great wind and rain at Wen Prefecture swept away city towers and government buildings.

sentences.zh: 元豐四年六月，邕州颶風，壞城樓、官私廬舍。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng year 4, sixth month: hurricane at Yong Prefecture; it damaged city towers and government and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth year of Yuanfeng, sixth month: a hurricane at Yong Prefecture damaged city towers and public and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午夜，泰州海風作，繼以大雨，浸州城，壞公私廬舍數千間。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on the night of day jiazi: sea wind at Taizhou; heavy rain followed; it inundated the prefectural city and damaged several thousand government and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, night of day jiazi: sea wind struck Taizhou, followed by heavy rain that flooded the prefectural city and destroyed several thousand buildings.

sentences.zh: 靜海縣大風雨，毀官私廬舍二千七百六十三楹。

translations.literal: At Jinghai County great wind and rain destroyed two thousand seven hundred sixty-three bays of government and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinghai County a great wind and rain destroyed 2,763 bays of public and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 丹陽縣大風雨，溺民居，毀廬舍。

translations.literal: At Danyang County great wind and rain drowned commoners' dwellings and destroyed houses.
translations.idiomatic: At Danyang County a great wind and rain flooded homes and wrecked buildings.

sentences.zh: 丹徒縣大風潮，飄蕩沿江廬舍，損田稼。

translations.literal: At Dantu County great wind and tidal surge scattered dwellings along the river and damaged field crops.
translations.idiomatic: At Dantu County a great wind and tidal surge swept away riverside dwellings and damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 六月，邕州颶風，壞城樓、官私廬舍。

translations.literal: Sixth month: hurricane at Yong Prefecture; it damaged city towers and government and private dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: a hurricane at Yong Prefecture damaged city towers and public and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，朱崖軍颶風，毀廬舍。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month: hurricane at Zhuyai Army; it destroyed dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: the fifth year of Yuanfeng, sixth month: a hurricane at Zhuyai Army destroyed buildings.

sentences.zh: 元祐八年，福建、兩浙海風駕潮，害民田。

translations.literal: Yuanyou year 8: sea winds driving tidal surge in Fujian and the two Zhe circuits harmed the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 8: sea winds driving tidal surge in Fujian and the two Zhe circuits damaged farmland.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年秋，蘇、湖、秀等州有風害民田。

translations.literal: Shaosheng year 1, autumn: Su, Hu, Xiu, and other prefectures suffered wind damage to the people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 1, autumn: wind damaged crops in Su, Hu, Xiu, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年正月望夜，大風起西北，有聲，吹沙走石，盡明日乃止。

translations.literal: Jingkang year 1, on the night of the full moon of the first month: a great wind rose from the northwest with sound; it blew sand and hurled stones; it did not stop until the next day was over.
translations.idiomatic: Jingkang 1, on the full-moon night of the first month: a great northwest wind roared, driving sand and hurling stones until it ceased only after the following day.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，大風起東北，揚塵翳空。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: a great wind rose from the northeast; it raised dust and veiled the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, day wushen: a great northeast wind raised dust and darkened the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳夜五更，大風乍緩乍急，聲如叫怒。

translations.literal: Third month, on the night of day jisi at the fifth watch: a great wind now slack now urgent; its sound was like shouting in rage.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, night of day jisi at the fifth watch: a great wind surged and slackened by turns, roaring like furious cries.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，大風髮屋折木。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai: a great wind tore off roofs and broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, day dinghai: a great wind tore off roofs and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月甲寅，大風起北方，雪作，盈數尺，連夜不止。

translations.literal: Intercalary eleventh month, day jiayin: a great wind rose from the north; snow fell several chi deep; it did not stop through the night.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary eleventh month, day jiayin: a great north wind brought snow several chi deep that fell without pause through the night.

sentences.zh: 二年正月巳亥，天氣昏噎，狂風迅發，竟日夜，西北陰雲中如有火光，長二丈餘，闊數尺，民時時見之。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month, day jihai: the weather was dark and choked; violent wind burst forth for a whole day and night; in the dark clouds of the northwest as if there were fire-light more than two zhang long and several chi wide; the people saw it from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Jingkang 2, first month, day jihai: the sky turned murky and a violent wind blew all day and night; in the northwestern clouds people repeatedly saw what looked like firelight more than two zhang long and several chi wide.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大風雨。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: great wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Day gengxu: a great wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，大風折木，晚尤甚。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: a great wind broke trees; it was especially severe in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, day yiyou: a great wind snapped trees, worst toward evening.

sentences.zh: 三月巳亥，大風。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, day jihai: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申朔，大風吹石折木。

translations.literal: Fourth month, first day gengshen: a great wind blew stones and broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, first day gengshen: a great wind hurled stones and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，北風益甚，苦寒。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: the north wind grew even stronger; bitter cold.
translations.idiomatic: Day xinyou: the north wind strengthened further and the cold was bitter.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年正月丁酉，大風吹石折木。

translations.literal: Jianyan year 1, first month, day dingyou: a great wind blew stones and broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyan 1, first month, day dingyou: a great wind hurled stones and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，大風拔木。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, day yiyou: a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 紹興二十八年七月壬戌，平江府大風雨駕潮，漂溺數百里，壞田廬。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 28, seventh month, day renxu: at Pingjiang Prefecture great wind and rain driving tidal surge drifted and drowned things for several hundred li and damaged fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 28, seventh month, day renxu: at Pingjiang Prefecture a great wind and rain driving tidal surge flooded hundreds of li of land and destroyed fields and houses.

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月戊申，大風拔木。

translations.literal: Year 32, seventh month, day wushen: a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 32, seventh month, day wushen: a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 溫州大風，壞屋覆舟。

translations.literal: At Wen Prefecture a great wind damaged houses and capsized boats.
translations.idiomatic: At Wen Prefecture a great wind wrecked houses and capsized boats.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，浙東、西郡國風水傷稼。

translations.literal: Longxing year 1: the prefectures and commanderies of eastern and western Zhe suffered wind and water damage to crops.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing 1: wind and flood damage to crops struck prefectures across eastern and western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，大風雨，漂蕩田廬。

translations.literal: In the second year, eighth month: great wind and rain; it drifted and swept away fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing 2, eighth month: a great wind and rain swept away fields and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年八月丁亥，溫州大風雨駕海潮，殺人覆舟，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: Qiandao year 2, eighth month, day dinghai: at Wen Prefecture great wind and rain driving sea tide killed people, capsized boats, and damaged dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 2, eighth month, day dinghai: at Wen Prefecture a great wind and rain driving the sea tide killed people, capsized boats, and wrecked buildings.

sentences.zh: 五年十月，台州大風水，壞田廬。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, tenth month: great wind and water at Tai Prefecture; it damaged fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 5, tenth month: great wind and flood at Tai Prefecture damaged fields and houses.

sentences.zh: 八年六月丙辰，惠州颶風，壞海艦三十餘。

translations.literal: Year 8, sixth month, day bingchen: hurricane at Hui Prefecture; it damaged more than thirty sea vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 8, sixth month, day bingchen: a hurricane at Hui Prefecture wrecked more than thirty sea vessels.

sentences.zh: 時樞密院調廣東經略司水軍，四艦覆其三，死者百三十餘人。

translations.literal: At the time the Bureau of Military Affairs dispatched naval forces of the Guangdong Pacification Commission; of four vessels three capsized; more than one hundred thirty people died.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Bureau of Military Affairs had ordered naval forces from the Guangdong Pacification Commission; three of four vessels capsized and more than 130 men drowned.

sentences.zh: 淳熙三年六月，大風連日。

translations.literal: Chunxi year 3, sixth month: a great wind for successive days.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 3, sixth month: a great wind blew for days on end.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，明州大風駕海潮，壞定海、鄞縣海岸七千六百餘丈及田廬、軍壘。

translations.literal: Year 4, ninth month: at Ming Prefecture a great wind driving sea tide damaged more than seven thousand six hundred zhang of coast at Dinghai and Yin County as well as fields, dwellings, and military fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 4, ninth month: at Ming Prefecture a great wind driving the sea tide damaged more than 7,600 zhang of coast at Dinghai and Yin County along with fields, houses, and military works.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳夜，福清縣、興化軍大風雨，壞官舍、民居、倉庫及海口鎮，人多死者。

translations.literal: Sixth month, night of day yisi: at Fuqing County and Xinghua Army great wind and rain damaged government buildings, common dwellings, granaries, and Haikou garrison; many people died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, night of day yisi: a great wind and rain at Fuqing County and Xinghua Army wrecked offices, homes, granaries, and Haikou garrison, killing many.

sentences.zh: 五年正月庚戌，大風。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month, day gengxu: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 5, first month, day gengxu: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，鄂州大風覆舟，溺人甚眾。

translations.literal: Year 6, eleventh month: at E Prefecture a great wind capsized boats; very many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 6, eleventh month: a great wind at E Prefecture capsized boats and drowned many people.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，江陵府大風，火及舟，焚溺死者尤眾。

translations.literal: Year 7, second month: at Jiangling Prefecture a great wind; fire spread to boats; those burned and drowned were especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 7, second month: a great wind at Jiangling Prefecture spread fire to boats; deaths by burning and drowning were especially heavy.

sentences.zh: 十年八月辛酉，雷州颶風大作，駕海潮傷人，禾稼、林木皆折。

translations.literal: Year 10, eighth month, day xinyou: hurricane at Lei Prefecture rose greatly; it drove sea tide and harmed people; grain crops and forest trees all broke.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 10, eighth month, day xinyou: a great hurricane at Lei Prefecture drove the sea tide, injuring people and snapping grain and trees.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年三月癸酉，瑞安縣大風，壞屋拔木殺人。

translations.literal: Shaoxi year 2, third month, day guiyou: at Rui'an County a great wind damaged houses, uprooted trees, and killed people.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 2, third month, day guiyou: a great wind at Rui'an County wrecked houses, uprooted trees, and killed people.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，興化軍海風害稼。

translations.literal: Year 4, seventh month: at Xinghua Army sea wind harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 4, seventh month: sea wind at Xinghua Army damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 五年六月丙子，大風。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month, day bingzi: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 5, sixth month, day bingzi: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥，行都大風拔木，壞舟甚眾。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day yihai: at the traveling capital a great wind uprooted trees and damaged very many boats.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, day yihai: a great wind at the traveling capital uprooted trees and wrecked many boats.

sentences.zh: 紹興府、秀州大風駕海潮，害稼。

translations.literal: At Shaoxing Prefecture and Xiu Prefecture a great wind driving sea tide harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: At Shaoxing Prefecture and Xiu Prefecture a great wind driving the sea tide damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 秋，明州颶風駕海潮，害稼。

translations.literal: Autumn: at Ming Prefecture a hurricane driving sea tide harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn a hurricane driving the sea tide at Ming Prefecture damaged crops.

sentences.zh: 十月甲戌，行都大風拔木。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiaxu: at the traveling capital a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, day jiaxu: a great wind at the traveling capital uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年六月壬申，台州暴風雨駕海潮，壞田廬。

translations.literal: Qingyuan year 2, sixth month, day renshen: at Tai Prefecture violent wind and rain driving sea tide damaged fields and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 2, sixth month, day renshen: a violent wind and rain driving the sea tide at Tai Prefecture damaged fields and houses.

sentences.zh: 六年三月甲子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: Year 6, third month, day jiazi: a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 6, third month, day jiazi: a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰三年十月丁未，暴風。

translations.literal: Jiatai year 3, tenth month, day dingwei: violent wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 3, tenth month, day dingwei: a violent wind.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，大風，四年正月乙亥亦如之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimei: a great wind; year 4, first month, day yihai, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, day guimei: a great wind; Jiatai 4, first month, day yihai, the same.

sentences.zh: 開禧元年四月乙卯、九月庚戌，大風。

translations.literal: Kaixi year 1, fourth month day yimao and ninth month day gengxu: great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Kaixi 1, fourth month day yimao and ninth month day gengxu: great wind.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年九月乙丑，大風。

translations.literal: Jiading year 1, ninth month, day yichou: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 1, ninth month, day yichou: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 二年二月戊子，大風。

translations.literal: Year 2, second month, day wuzi: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 2, second month, day wuzi: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，台州大風雨駕海潮，壞屋殺人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renchen: at Tai Prefecture great wind and rain driving sea tide damaged houses and killed people.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, day renchen: a great wind and rain driving the sea tide at Tai Prefecture wrecked houses and killed people.

sentences.zh: 三年八月癸酉，大風拔木，折禾穗，墮果實。

translations.literal: Year 3, eighth month, day guiyou: a great wind uprooted trees, broke grain heads, and fruit fell.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 3, eighth month, day guiyou: a great wind uprooted trees, shattered grain heads, and knocked fruit from the trees.

sentences.zh: 寧宗露禱，至於丙子乃息。

translations.literal: Emperor Ningzong prayed in the open; it did not cease until day bingzi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ningzong prayed in the open air; the wind did not abate until day bingzi.

sentences.zh: 後御史朝陵於紹興府，歸奏風壞陵殿宮牆六十餘所、陵木二千余章。

translations.literal: Later a censor paid court to the imperial tombs at Shaoxing Prefecture; on returning he reported that wind had damaged more than sixty tomb halls and palace walls and more than two thousand tomb trees.
translations.idiomatic: Later a censor attended the imperial tombs at Shaoxing Prefecture and reported on his return that wind had damaged more than sixty tomb halls and palace walls and more than 2,000 tomb trees.

sentences.zh: 四年閏月丁未​​，大風。

translations.literal: Year 4, intercalary month, day dingwei: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 4, intercalary month, day dingwei: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 六年十二月，餘姚縣風潮壞海堤，亙八鄉。

translations.literal: Year 6, twelfth month: at Yuyao County wind and tidal surge damaged sea dikes spanning eight townships.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 6, twelfth month: wind and tidal surge at Yuyao County broke sea dikes across eight townships.

sentences.zh: 七年正月庚辰，江州放鐙，黑雲暴風忽作，遊人相踐，死者二十餘。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, first month, day gengchen: at Jiang Prefecture during the lantern festival black clouds and violent wind suddenly arose; sightseers trampled one another; more than twenty died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 7, first month, day gengchen: during the lantern festival at Jiang Prefecture black clouds and a sudden violent wind sent crowds trampling one another; more than twenty died.

sentences.zh: 十年正月乙未，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, first month, day yiwei: a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 10, first month, day yiwei: a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，大風。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, day dingchou: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月甲寅，大風。

translations.literal: Year 11, second month, day jiayin: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 11, second month, day jiayin: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，大風。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuwu: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, day wuwu: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 十三年十一月庚戌、壬子，大風。

translations.literal: Year 13, eleventh month, days gengxu and renzi: great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 13, eleventh month, days gengxu and renzi: great wind.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，大風。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, day wuwu: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月辛巳，大風。

translations.literal: Year 14, sixth month, day xinsi: a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 14, sixth month, day xinsi: a great wind.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋，大風拔木害稼，十七年秋，福州颶風大作，壞田損稼。

translations.literal: Year 16, autumn: a great wind uprooted trees and harmed crops; year 17, autumn: at Fuzhou a hurricane rose greatly; it damaged fields and harmed crops.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 16, autumn: a great wind uprooted trees and damaged crops; Jiading 17, autumn: a great hurricane at Fuzhou wrecked fields and crops.

sentences.zh: 冬，鄂州暴風，壞戰艦二百餘，壽昌軍壞戰艦六十餘，江州、興國亦如之。

translations.literal: Winter: at E Prefecture violent wind damaged more than two hundred warships; at Shouchang Army more than sixty warships were damaged; Jiang Prefecture and Xingguo were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: That winter violent wind at E Prefecture wrecked more than 200 warships; Shouchang Army lost more than 60 warships; Jiang Prefecture and Xingguo suffered likewise.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙二年，風雹。

translations.literal: Jiaxi year 2: wind and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxi 2: wind and hail.

sentences.zh: 三年，風雹。

translations.literal: Year 3: wind and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxi 3: wind and hail.

sentences.zh: 淳祐十一年，泰州風。

translations.literal: Chunyou year 11: wind at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyou 11: wind at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 景定四年十一月，福州颶風。

translations.literal: Jingding year 4, eleventh month: hurricane at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jingding 4, eleventh month: a hurricane at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸淳四年閏月丁巳，大風雷雨，居民屋瓦皆動。

translations.literal: Xianchun year 4, intercalary month, day dingsi: great wind, thunder, and rain; roof tiles of commoners' dwellings all shook.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 4, intercalary month, day dingsi: a great wind with thunder and rain shook the roof tiles of every house.

sentences.zh: 七年五月甲申，紹興府大風。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, day jiashen: a great wind at Shaoxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 7, fifth month, day jiashen: a great wind at Shaoxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，紹興府大風拔木。

translations.literal: Year 10, fourth month: at Shaoxing Prefecture a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 10, fourth month: a great wind at Shaoxing Prefecture uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，京師暴風起東北，塵沙曀日，人不相辨。

translations.literal: Duangong year 2: a violent wind rose in the northeast of the capital; dust and sand darkened the sun; people could not recognize one another.
translations.idiomatic: Duangong 2: a violent wind from the northeast of the capital darkened the sun with dust; people could not see one another.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年六月丁丑，黑風自西北起，天地晦冥，雷震，有頃乃止。
