translations.literal: Duangong year 1: Chen Xijian, a commoner of Mei Prefecture; Zhang Zhaoyu, a commoner of Jinyuan County; Xianyu Gao, a commoner of Weicheng County; Yuan Zu, a commoner of Luojiang County; Li Mei, a commoner of Heyang County; Zeng Qian, a commoner of Qushui County; Wen Guangyi, a commoner of Zitong County; Luo De, a commoner of Yongtai County; and Chen Hong, a commoner of Mianzhu County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Duangong 1: Chen Xijian of Mei Prefecture, Zhang Zhaoyu of Jinyuan County, Xianyu Gao of Weicheng County, Yuan Zu of Luojiang County, Li Mei of Heyang County, Zeng Qian of Qushui County, Wen Guangyi of Zitong County, Luo De of Yongtai County, and Chen Hong of Mianzhu County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年，綿竹縣民李昌遠薄逸、閬州民和中、忠州民民王欽、眉州王圖、九隴縣民楊皋、玄武縣民羊邁達牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Chunhua year 1: Li Changyuan and Bo Yi, commoners of Mianzhu County; He Zhong, a commoner of Lang Prefecture; Wang Qin, a commoner of Zhong Prefecture; Wang Tu of Mei Prefecture; Yang Gao, a commoner of Jiulong County; and Yang Maida, a commoner of Xuanwu County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 1: Li Changyuan and Bo Yi of Mianzhu County, He Zhong of Lang Prefecture, Wang Qin of Zhong Prefecture, Wang Tu of Mei Prefecture, Yang Gao of Jiulong County, and Yang Maida of Xuanwu County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 二年，永川縣民梁行良、仁壽縣民梁仁超牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Liang Xingliang, a commoner of Yongchuan County, and Liang Renchao, a commoner of Renshou County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 2: Liang Xingliang of Yongchuan County and Liang Renchao of Renshou County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 三年，成都府民彭齊卿、洪雅縣民程讓、永昌縣民田昭、巴州民杜文宥、廬山縣民白閏牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Peng Qiqing, a commoner of Chengdu Prefecture; Cheng Rang, a commoner of Hongya County; Tian Zhao, a commoner of Yongchang County; Du Wenyou, a commoner of Ba Prefecture; and Bai Run, a commoner of Lushan County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 3: Peng Qiqing of Chengdu Prefecture, Cheng Rang of Hongya County, Tian Zhao of Yongchang County, Du Wenyou of Ba Prefecture, and Bai Run of Lushan County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 四年，成都府民任順、曲水縣民張思方、彭山縣民李承遠牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Ren Shun, a commoner of Chengdu Prefecture; Zhang Sifang, a commoner of Qushui County; and Li Chengyuan, a commoner of Pengshan County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 4: Ren Shun of Chengdu Prefecture, Zhang Sifang of Qushui County, and Li Chengyuan of Pengshan County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，新都縣民蹇成美牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Zhidao year 2: Jian Chengmei, a commoner of Xindu County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhidao 2: Jian Chengmei, a commoner of Xindu County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 潁陽縣民馮延密牛生二犢，其二額有白。

translations.literal: Feng Yanmi, a commoner of Yingyang County, had a cow that bore two calves; the two had white on their foreheads.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yanmi, a commoner of Yingyang County, had a cow that bore twin calves, both with white on their foreheads.

sentences.zh: 三年，新津縣民文承富、赤水縣民蘇福、廣安軍吏胥仁迪牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Wen Chengfu, a commoner of Xinjin County; Su Fu, a commoner of Chishui County; and Xu Rendí, a clerk of Guang'an Army, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhidao 3: Wen Chengfu of Xinjin County, Su Fu of Chishui County, and Xu Rendí, a clerk of Guang'an Army, had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，眉山縣民向瓊玖陳元寶、丹稜縣民劉承鶚、通泉縣民王居中、曲水縣民楊漢成楊景歡王師讓、眉山縣民陳彥宥牛生三犢。

translations.literal: Xianping year 1: Xiang Qiongjia and Chen Yuanbao, commoners of Meishan County; Liu Chenge, a commoner of Danling County; Wang Juzhong, a commoner of Tongquan County; Yang Hancheng, Yang Jinghuan, and Wang Shirang, commoners of Qushui County; and Chen Yanyou, a commoner of Meishan County, had cows that bore three calves.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 1: Xiang Qiongjia and Chen Yuanbao of Meishan County, Liu Chenge of Danling County, Wang Juzhong of Tongquan County, Yang Hancheng, Yang Jinghuan, and Wang Shirang of Qushui County, and Chen Yanyou of Meishan County had cows that bore triplets.

sentences.zh: 二年，蒙陽縣民杜摯、九隴縣民楊太、眉山縣民蘇仁義、洪雅縣吏陸文贊牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Du Zhi, a commoner of Mengyang County; Yang Tai, a commoner of Jiulong County; Su Renyi, a commoner of Meishan County; and Lu Wenzan, a clerk of Hongya County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 2: Du Zhi of Mengyang County, Yang Tai of Jiulong County, Su Renyi of Meishan County, and Lu Wenzan, a clerk of Hongya County, had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 三年，敘浦縣民戴昌蘊牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Dai Changyun, a commoner of Xupu County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 3: Dai Changyun, a commoner of Xupu County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 四年，流溪縣民何承添、晉原縣民頗全、永昌縣民曾嗣、犀浦縣民何福、彰明縣民王巳牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 4: He Chengtian, a commoner of Liuxi County; Po Quan, a commoner of Jinyuan County; Zeng Si, a commoner of Yongchang County; He Fu, a commoner of Xipu County; and Wang Si, a commoner of Zhangming County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 4: He Chengtian of Liuxi County, Po Quan of Jinyuan County, Zeng Si of Yongchang County, He Fu of Xipu County, and Wang Si of Zhangming County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 六年，渠江縣民王德進、魏城民蒲諫王信、石照縣民仲漢宗、大足縣民劉武牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 6: Wang Dejin, a commoner of Qujiang County; Pu Jian and Wang Xin, commoners of Weicheng County; Zhong Hanzong, a commoner of Shizhao County; and Liu Wu, a commoner of Dazu County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 6: Wang Dejin of Qujiang County, Pu Jian and Wang Xin of Weicheng County, Zhong Hanzong of Shizhao County, and Liu Wu of Dazu County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 景德元年，魏城縣民閻明、彭州濛陽縣民郭琮牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Jingde year 1: Yan Ming, a commoner of Weicheng County, and Guo Cong, a commoner of Mengyang County, Peng Prefecture, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 1: Yan Ming of Weicheng County and Guo Cong of Mengyang County, Peng Prefecture, had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 二年，三泉縣民李景順、東海縣民時祐、小溪縣民劉可、赤水縣民羅永並牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Li Jingshun, a commoner of Sanquan County; Shi You, a commoner of Donghai County; Liu Ke, a commoner of Xiaoxi County; and Luo Yong, a commoner of Chishui County, all had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 2: Li Jingshun of Sanquan County, Shi You of Donghai County, Liu Ke of Xiaoxi County, and Luo Yong of Chishui County all had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 三年，長江縣民於承琛牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Yu Chengchen, a commoner of Changjiang County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 3: Yu Chengchen, a commoner of Changjiang County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 四年，相如縣民楊漢暉、邛州安仁縣民羅瑩、九隴縣民白彥成、渠江縣民王繼豐家及順安軍屯田務牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Yang Hanhui, a commoner of Xiangru County; Luo Ying, a commoner of Anren County, Qiong Prefecture; Bai Yancheng, a commoner of Jiulong County; the household of Wang Jifeng, a commoner of Qujiang County; and the Tuntian office of Shun'an Army had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 4: Yang Hanhui of Xiangru County, Luo Ying of Anren County in Qiong Prefecture, Bai Yancheng of Jiulong County, Wang Jifeng's household of Qujiang County, and the military colony farm at Shun'an Army all had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年，龔丘縣民李起牛生四犢，判州王欽若圖以獻。

translations.literal: Dazhong Xiangfu year 1: Li Qi, a commoner of Gongqiu County, had a cow that bore four calves; acting prefect Wang Qinruo drew it and presented the picture.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 1: Li Qi, a commoner of Gongqiu County, had a cow that bore four calves; Acting Prefect Wang Qinruo drew it and presented the picture to the throne.

sentences.zh: 二年，立山縣民盧仁依、銅山縣民勾熙正、什邡縣民杜族、南康縣陳邦並牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Lu Renyi, a commoner of Lishan County; Gou Xizheng, a commoner of Tongshan County; Du Zu, a commoner of Shifang County; and Chen Bang of Nankang County all had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 2: Lu Renyi of Lishan County, Gou Xizheng of Tongshan County, Du Zu of Shifang County, and Chen Bang of Nankang County all had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 三年，犍為縣民陳知進牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 3: Chen Zhijin, a commoner of Qianwei County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 3: Chen Zhijin, a commoner of Qianwei County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 四年，東關縣民陳知進牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Chen Zhijin, a commoner of Dongguan County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 4: Chen Zhijin, a commoner of Dongguan County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 五年，富順監些井場官楊守忠、曲水縣民向平、蓬溪縣民蹇知密牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 5: Yang Shouzhong, an official of the Xiejing field office of Fushun Supervisorate; Xiang Ping, a commoner of Qushui County; and Jian Zhimin, a commoner of Pengxi County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 5: Yang Shouzhong, an official of the Xiejing field office at Fushun Supervisorate, Xiang Ping of Qushui County, and Jian Zhimin of Pengxi County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 六年，廣安軍依政縣民李福、貴溪縣民徐志元牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 6: Li Fu, a commoner of Yizheng County, Guang'an Army, and Xu Zhiyuan, a commoner of Guixi County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 6: Li Fu of Yizheng County in Guang'an Army and Xu Zhiyuan of Guixi County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 七年，雙流縣民姚彥信、涪城縣民張禮、嘉州龍遊縣民張正、夾江縣民郭升、天水縣民王吉牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 7: Yao Yanxin, a commoner of Shuangliu County; Zhang Li, a commoner of Fucheng County; Zhang Zheng, a commoner of Longyou County, Jia Prefecture; Guo Sheng, a commoner of Jiajiang County; and Wang Ji, a commoner of Tianshui County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 7: Yao Yanxin of Shuangliu County, Zhang Li of Fucheng County, Zhang Zheng of Longyou County in Jia Prefecture, Guo Sheng of Jiajiang County, and Wang Ji of Tianshui County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 八年，仁壽縣民何志、通泉縣民罷永泰、成都縣民張進、華陽縣民楊承珂牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 8: He Zhi, a commoner of Renshou County; Ba Yongtai, a commoner of Tongquan County; Zhang Jin, a commoner of Chengdu County; and Yang Chengke, a commoner of Huayang County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 8: He Zhi of Renshou County, Ba Yongtai of Tongquan County, Zhang Jin of Chengdu County, and Yang Chengke of Huayang County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 九年，平定軍平定縣民範訓、臨邛縣民楊暉牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 9: Fan Xun, a commoner of Pingding County, Pingding Army, and Yang Hui, a commoner of Linqiong County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 9: Fan Xun of Pingding County in Pingding Army and Yang Hui of Linqiong County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，開江縣民冉津及澧州石門縣層山院牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Tianxi year 1: Ran Jin, a commoner of Kaijiang County, and Cengshan Monastery of Shimen County, Li Prefecture, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 1: Ran Jin of Kaijiang County and Cengshan Monastery in Shimen County, Li Prefecture, had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 二年，臨邛縣民王道進、臨溪縣民王勝、西縣民韓光緒牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Wang Daojin, a commoner of Linqiong County; Wang Sheng, a commoner of Linxi County; and Han Guangxu, a commoner of Xi County, had cows that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 2: Wang Daojin of Linqiong County, Wang Sheng of Linxi County, and Han Guangxu of Xi County had cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 四年，貴溪縣民葉政牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Ye Zheng, a commoner of Guixi County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 4: Ye Zheng, a commoner of Guixi County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 五年，巴西縣民向知道牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 5: Xiang Zhidao, a commoner of Baxi County, had a cow that bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 5: Xiang Zhidao, a commoner of Baxi County, had a cow that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 自天聖迄治平，牛生二犢者三十二，生三犢者一。

translations.literal: From Tiansheng through Zhiping, there were thirty-two cases of cows bearing two calves and one case bearing three calves.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tiansheng era through Zhiping, cows bore twin calves in thirty-two instances and triplets in one.

sentences.zh: 自熙寧二年距元豐八年，郡國言民家牛生二犢者三十有五，生三角者一。

translations.literal: From Xining year 2 through Yuanfeng year 8, the commanderies reported thirty-five cases of commoners' cows bearing two calves and one bearing three horns.
translations.idiomatic: From Xining 2 through the eighth year of Yuanfeng, the commanderies reported thirty-five households whose cows bore twin calves and one calf born with three horns.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年距元符三年，郡國言民家牛生二犢者十有五。

translations.literal: From Yuanyou year 1 through Yuanfu year 3, the commanderies reported fifteen cases of commoners' cows bearing two calves.
translations.idiomatic: From Yuanyou 1 through Yuanfu 3, the commanderies reported fifteen instances of commoners' cows bearing twin calves.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年，閬州、達州言牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Daguan year 1: Lang and Da prefectures reported cows bearing two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Daguan 1: Lang and Da prefectures reported cows that bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，帝謂起居舍人宇文粹中曰：“牛產二犢，亦載之起居注中，豈若野蠶成繭之類，民賴其利，乃為瑞邪？”

translations.literal: Fourth year, third month: The emperor said to Attendant Diarist Yu Wen Cuizhong, "Cows producing twin calves are also recorded in the Veritable Records—are they auspicious signs like wild silkworms forming cocoons, where the people benefit from the profit?"
translations.idiomatic: Daguan 4, third month: The emperor said to Attendant Diarist Yuwen Cuizhong, "Twin calves are still entered in the Veritable Records—yet are they truly omens of good fortune, like wild silkworms spinning cocoons, where the people gain some practical benefit?"

sentences.zh: 自是史官不復盡書。

translations.literal: From then on the historiographers no longer recorded them all.
translations.idiomatic: After that the court historians ceased recording every such case.

sentences.zh: 政和五年七月，安武軍言，郡縣民範濟家牛生麒麟。

translations.literal: Zhenghe year 5, seventh month: Anwu Army reported that the household of Fan Ji, a commoner of the prefecture and counties, had a cow bear a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 5, seventh month: Anwu Army reported that Fan Ji's household in the district had a cow that bore a creature resembling a qilin.

sentences.zh: 重和元年三月，陝州言牛生麒麟。

translations.literal: Chonghe year 1, third month: Shaan Prefecture reported a cow bore a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghe 1, third month: Shaan Prefecture reported a cow that bore a qilin-like calf.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年十月，尚書省言，歙州歙縣民鮑珙家牛生麒麟。

translations.literal: Xuanhe year 2, tenth month: The Ministry of Rites reported that the household of Bao Gong, a commoner of She County, She Prefecture, had a cow bear a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 2, tenth month: The Ministry of Rites reported that Bao Gong's household in She County, She Prefecture, had a cow that bore a qilin-like calf.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，梁縣民邢喜家牛生麒麟。

translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month: The household of Xing Xi, a commoner of Liang County, had a cow bear a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 3, fifth month: Xing Xi's household in Liang County had a cow that bore a qilin-like calf.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，紹興府有牛戴刃突入城市，觸馬，裂腹出腸。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 1: In Shaoxing Prefecture a cow wearing a blade on its head burst into the city, struck a horse, and split its belly so its intestines spilled out.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 1: At Shaoxing Prefecture a cow with a blade on its head charged into the city, struck a horse, and tore open its belly so its intestines spilled out.

sentences.zh: 時衛卒多犯禁屠牛，牛受刃而逸，近牛禍也。

translations.literal: At the time many guardsmen violated the ban on slaughtering cattle; the cow had been wounded by a blade and escaped—this approached a cattle portent.
translations.idiomatic: At the time many guardsmen were violating the ban on slaughtering cattle; the cow had been wounded and fled—an omen close to a cattle calamity.

sentences.zh: 十六年，靜江府城北二十里，有奔犢以角觸人於壁，腸胃出，牛狂走，兩日不可執，卒以射死。

translations.literal: Year 16: Twenty li north of Jingjiang Prefecture city, a running calf gored a person against a wall so his bowels spilled out; the ox ran madly and for two days could not be seized; it was finally shot dead.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 16: Twenty li north of Jingjiang Prefecture city, a charging calf gored a man against a wall until his bowels spilled out; the ox ran wild and could not be caught for two days and was finally shot dead.

sentences.zh: 十八年五月，依政縣牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 18, fifth month: at Yizheng County cows bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 18, fifth month: cows at Yizheng County bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 二十一年七月，遂寧府牛生二犢者三。

translations.literal: Year 21, seventh month: at Suining Prefecture three cases of cows bearing two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 21, seventh month: three cows at Suining Prefecture bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月，漢中牛生二犢。

translations.literal: Year 25, eighth month: at Hanzhong cows bore two calves.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 25, eighth month: cows at Hanzhong bore twin calves.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十二年，仁和縣良渚有牛生二首，七日而死。

translations.literal: Chunxi year 12: At Liangzhu in Renhe County a cow bore a calf with two heads; after seven days it died.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 12: At Liangzhu in Renhe County a cow bore a two-headed calf that died after seven days.

sentences.zh: 餘杭縣有犢二首。

translations.literal: In Yuhang County there was a calf with two heads.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuhang County a calf was born with two heads.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月，池州池口鎮軍屯牛狂走，觸人死。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, third month: Military colony cattle at Chikou Town, Chi Prefecture ran wild, trampled people, and killed them.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 16, third month: Garrison farm cattle at Chikou Town in Chi Prefecture went mad, charged into crowds, and killed people.

sentences.zh: 慶元三年，樂平縣田家牛生犢如馬，一角，鱗身肉尾，農以不祥殺之，或惜其為麟；

translations.literal: Qingyuan year 3: At a farming household in Leping County a cow bore a calf like a horse, with one horn, a scaly body, and a fleshy tail; the farmers killed it as inauspicious, though some regretted that it might have been a qilin;
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 3: At a farm in Leping County a cow bore a calf shaped like a horse, with one horn, scales, and a fleshy tail; the farmers slaughtered it as an ill omen, though some mourned what they thought might have been a qilin;

sentences.zh: 同縣萬山牛生犢，人首。

translations.literal: In the same county at Wanshan a cow bore a calf with a human head.
translations.idiomatic: In the same county, at Wanshan, a cow bore a calf with a human head.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年正月乙卯，京師雨土，占曰：“小人叛。”

translations.literal: Chunhua year 3, first month, day yimao: earth rained in the capital; the prognostication said, "Petty men rebel."
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 3, first month, on the yimao day, dust fell from the sky over the capital; the omen read, "Petty men will rebel."

sentences.zh: 自後李順盜據益州。

translations.literal: After this Li Shun seized and held Yizhou in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Li Shun rose in rebellion and seized Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 景德元年七月辛亥，黃氣出壁，長五尺餘，占曰：“兵出。”

translations.literal: Jingde year 1, seventh month, day xinhai: yellow vapor issued from Bi, more than five chi long; the prognostication said, "Armies march."
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 1, seventh month, on the xinhai day, yellow vapor issued from the Wall constellation, stretching more than five chi; the omen read, "Armies will march."

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙寅，黃白氣環之。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month, day bingyin: yellow-white vapor encircled it.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 2, first month, on the bingyin day, yellow-white vapor ringed it.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年正月癸亥朔，黃氣出於艮，占曰：“主五穀熟。”

translations.literal: Dazhong Xiangfu year 1, first month, day guihai, new moon: yellow vapor issued from Gen; the prognostication said, "The five grains ripen."
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 1, on the guihai new moon of the first month, yellow vapor rose from the Gen direction; the omen read, "The five grains will ripen."

sentences.zh: 二年九月戊午，黃氣如柱起東南方，長五丈許。

translations.literal: In the second year, ninth month, day wuwu: yellow vapor like a pillar rose in the southeast, about five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 2, ninth month, on the wuwu day, a pillar of yellow vapor rose in the southeast, roughly five zhang in height.

sentences.zh: 天禧五年，襄州鳳林鎮道側地湧起，高三尺，闊八尺，知州夏辣以聞。

translations.literal: Tianxi year 5: By the roadside at Fenglin Town, Xiang Prefecture, the ground swelled up three chi high and eight chi wide; Prefect Xia La reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi 5: Along the road at Fenglin Town in Xiang Prefecture the earth bulged upward three chi high and eight chi across; Prefect Xia La memorialized the court.

sentences.zh: 明道元年十月庚子夜，黃白氣五，貫紫微垣。

translations.literal: Mingdao year 1, tenth month, day gengzi, at night: five yellow-white vapors pierced the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Mingdao 1, tenth month, on the gengzi night, five streaks of yellow-white vapor cut through the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年八月壬戌夜，有黃白氣如彗，長七尺餘，出張、翼之上，凡三十有三日不見。

translations.literal: Jingyou year 1, eighth month, day renxu, at night: there was yellow-white vapor like a comet, more than seven chi long, issuing above Zhang and Yi; after thirty-three days it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou 1, eighth month, on the renxu night, a comet-like plume of yellow-white vapor more than seven chi long appeared above the Zhang and Yi asterisms; thirty-three days later it vanished.

sentences.zh: 治平元年三月壬戌，雨土。

translations.literal: Zhiping year 1, third month, day renxu: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiping 1, third month, on the renxu day, dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，雨黃土。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: yellow earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on the jihai day, yellow earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年十二月癸未、七年三月戊午，并雨黃土。

translations.literal: Xining year 5, twelfth month, day guiwei, and year 7, third month, day wuwu: both times yellow earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 5, twelfth month, on the guiwei day, and Xining 7, third month, on the wuwu day, yellow earth fell from the sky on both occasions.

sentences.zh: 八年五月丁丑，雨黃土兼細毛。

translations.literal: Year 8, fifth month, day dingchou: yellow earth rained together with fine hair.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 8, fifth month, on the dingchou day, yellow earth fell mixed with fine hair.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年十一月丁亥、五年三月乙巳、六年四月辛未，雨土。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng year 2, eleventh month, day dinghai; year 5, third month, day yisi; and year 6, fourth month, day xinwei: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: the second year of Yuanfeng, eleventh month, on the dinghai day; the fifth year of Yuanfeng, third month, on the yisi day; and the sixth year of Yuanfeng, fourth month, on the xinwei day: dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 元祐七年正月戊午，天雨塵土，主民勞苦。

translations.literal: Yuanyou year 7, first month, day wuwu: the sky rained dust and earth; it portends the people's toil and suffering.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 7, first month, on the wuwu day, dust and earth rained from the sky—an omen of the people's exhaustion and hardship.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年三月庚午，雨土著衣，主不肖者食祿。

translations.literal: Xuanhe year 1, third month, day gengwu: earth rained and clung to clothing; it portends the unworthy consuming stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 1, third month, on the gengwu day, falling earth stuck to people's clothes—an omen that the unworthy were drawing official salaries.

sentences.zh: 紹興十一年三月庚申，涇州雨黃沙。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 11, third month, day gengshen: Jing Prefecture rained yellow sand.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 11, third month, on the gengshen day, yellow sand fell over Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十八年十一月壬辰，肆赦，天有云赤黃，近黃祥也，太史附秦檜旨奏瑞。

translations.literal: Year 18, eleventh month, day renchen: a general amnesty was proclaimed; the sky had red-yellow clouds, close to a yellow auspice; the Grand Astrologer, aligning with Qin Hui's intent, memorialized it as auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 18, eleventh month, on the renchen day, as a general amnesty was proclaimed, red-yellow clouds filled the sky—a near instance of yellow auspice; the Grand Astrologer, echoing Qin Hui's wishes, reported it as a blessing.

sentences.zh: 乾道四年三月己丑，雨土若塵。

translations.literal: Qiandao year 4, third month, day jichou: earth rained like dust.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 4, third month, on the jichou day, dust fell from the sky like rain.

sentences.zh: 淳熙四年二月戊戌，雨土，五年二月壬午、甲申、四月丁丑、六年十一月乙丑、十一年正月辛卯、甲寅、十三年正月壬寅，亦如之。

translations.literal: Chunxi year 4, second month, day wuxu: earth rained; also in year 5, second month, days rewu and jiashen; fourth month, day dingchou; year 6, eleventh month, day yichou; year 11, first month, days xinmao and jiayin; and year 13, first month, day renyin.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 4, second month, on the wuxu day, dust fell from the sky; the same occurred on Chunxi 5, second month, rewu and jiashen; fourth month, dingchou; Chunxi 6, eleventh month, yichou; Chunxi 11, first month, xinmao and jiayin; and Chunxi 13, first month, renyin.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月庚子，南方有赤黃氣。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, ninth month, day gengzi: in the south there was red-yellow vapor.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 15, ninth month, on the gengzi day, red-yellow vapor appeared in the south.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年十月甲寅，雨土，五年四月癸卯亦如之。

translations.literal: Shaoxi year 4, tenth month, day jiayin: earth rained; year 5, fourth month, day guimao, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 4, tenth month, on the jiayin day, dust fell from the sky; Shaoxi 5, fourth month, on the guimao day, likewise.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，天有赤黃色，占曰：“是為天變。”

translations.literal: Tenth month, day yimwei: the sky had a red-yellow color; the prognostication said, "This is a celestial transformation."
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, on the yimwei day, the sky turned red-yellow; the omen read, "This is a transformation of Heaven."

sentences.zh: 色先赤後黃，近黃赤祥也。

translations.literal: The color was red first and then yellow—a near instance of yellow-red auspice.
translations.idiomatic: The hue shifted from red to yellow—a sign close to yellow-red auspice.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，雨土。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the xinhai day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年二月己卯、十一月己丑，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Qingyuan year 1, second month, day jimao, and eleventh month, day jichou: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 1, second month, on the jimao day, and eleventh month, on the jichou day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙子、四月丙午、十二月甲申，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month, day bingzi; fourth month, day bingwu; and twelfth month, day jiashen: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 3, first month, on the bingzi day; fourth month, on the bingwu day; and twelfth month, on the jiashen day: dust and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 六年正月己巳、閏月丁未、十月己丑，雨土。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month, day jisi; intercalary month, day dingwei; and tenth month, day jichou: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 6, first month, on the jisi day; intercalary month, on the dingwei day; and tenth month, on the jichou day: dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑、十一月辛卯，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou, and eleventh month, day xinmao: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the xinchou day, and eleventh month, on the xinmao day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰元年六月己卯、九月己未、十二月辛丑，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Jiatai year 1, sixth month, day jimao; ninth month, day jiwei; and twelfth month, day xinchou: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 1, sixth month, on the jimao day; ninth month, on the jiwei day; and twelfth month, on the xinchou day: dust and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 嘉定三年正月丙午，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Jiading year 3, first month, day bingwu: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 3, first month, on the bingwu day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 八年二月己未、五月辛未，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Year 8, second month, day jiwei, and fifth month, day xinwei: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 8, second month, on the jiwei day, and fifth month, on the xinwei day, dust and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 九年十二月癸巳，天雨土。

translations.literal: Year 9, twelfth month, day guisi: the sky rained earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 9, twelfth month, on the guisi day, earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十年二月癸巳，雨土。

translations.literal: Year 10, second month, day guisi: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 10, second month, on the guisi day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月癸巳，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Year 12, second month, day guisi: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 12, second month, on the guisi day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月辛卯，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Year 13, third month, day xinmao: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 13, third month, on the xinmao day, dust and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月戊子，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Year 16, second month, day wuzi: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 16, second month, on the wuzi day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 紹定三年三月丁酉，雨土。

translations.literal: Shaoding year 3, third month, day dingyou: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoding 3, third month, on the dingyou day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙二年四月甲申，雨土。

translations.literal: Jiaxi year 2, fourth month, day jiashen: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxi 2, fourth month, on the jiashen day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三年三月辛卯，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Year 3, third month, day xinmao: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxi 3, third month, on the xinmao day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 淳祐五年二月丙寅朔，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Chunyou year 5, second month, day bingyin, new moon: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyou 5, on the bingyin new moon of the second month, dust and earth fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月乙亥，天雨塵。

translations.literal: Year 11, third month, day yihai: the sky rained dust.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyou 11, third month, on the yihai day, dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 寶祐三年三月己未，雨土。

translations.literal: Baoyou year 3, third month, day jiwei: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyou 3, third month, on the jiwei day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 六年二月壬辰，天雨塵土。

translations.literal: Year 6, second month, day renchen: the sky rained dust and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyou 6, second month, on the renchen day, dust and earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年三月辛酉，雨土。

translations.literal: Kaiqing year 1, third month, day xinyou: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiqing 1, third month, on the xinyou day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 景定五年二月辛未，雨土。

translations.literal: Jingding year 5, second month, day xinwei: earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Jingding 5, second month, on the xinwei day, dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年三月辛巳，終日黃沙蔽天，或曰“喪氛”。

translations.literal: Deyou year 1, third month, day xinsi: all day yellow sand blocked the sky; some called it "mourning vapor."
translations.idiomatic: Deyou 1, third month, on the xinsi day, yellow sand blotted out the sky all day long; some called it the vapor of mourning.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年，京師地震，史失日月。

translations.literal: Qiande year 3: the capital suffered an earthquake; the historians lost the month and day.
translations.idiomatic: Qiande 3: the capital was shaken by an earthquake, though the historians failed to record the month and day.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月，許州開元觀老君像自動，知州宋偓以聞。

translations.literal: Year 5, eleventh month: the Laozi image at Kaiyuan Abbey, Xu Prefecture, moved of itself; Prefect Song Wo reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Qiande 5, eleventh month: the statue of Laozi at Kaiyuan Abbey in Xu Prefecture shifted on its own; Prefect Song Wo memorialized the court.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，簡州普通院毘廬佛像自動。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month: the Vairocana Buddha image at Putong Monastery, Jian Prefecture, moved of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Qiande 6, first month: the Vairocana Buddha image at Putong Monastery in Jian Prefecture moved of its own accord.

sentences.zh: 至道二年十月，潼關西至靈州、夏州、環慶等州地震，城郭廬舍多壞，占云：“兵飢。”

translations.literal: Zhidao year 2, tenth month: from Tong Pass west to Ling, Xia, Huanqing, and other prefectures there were earthquakes; city walls and buildings were mostly destroyed; the prognostication said, "War and famine."
translations.idiomatic: Zhidao 2, tenth month: earthquakes struck from Tong Pass westward through Ling, Xia, Huanqing, and neighboring prefectures, shattering walls and buildings; the prognostication said, "War and famine."

sentences.zh: 是時，西夏寇靈州，明年，遣將率兵援糧以救之，關西民飢。

translations.literal: At that time Western Xia raided Ling Prefecture; the next year generals were sent with troops to escort grain to relieve it, and the people of Guanxi suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Western Xia raided Ling Prefecture; the following year imperial generals marched with grain convoys to relieve the siege, even as the people of Guanxi starved.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年九月，常州地震，壞鼓角樓、羅務、軍民廬舍甚眾。

translations.literal: Xianping year 2, ninth month: Chang Prefecture suffered an earthquake that destroyed the drum-and-watchtower, patrol offices, and numerous military and civilian buildings.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 2, ninth month: an earthquake struck Chang Prefecture, wrecking the drum tower, patrol offices, and a great many military and civilian buildings.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，慶州地震者再。

translations.literal: Year 4, ninth month: Qing Prefecture was shaken twice.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 4, ninth month: Qing Prefecture was hit by two earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，益州地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month: Yizhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 6, first month: Yizhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 景德元年正月丙申夜，京師地震；

translations.literal: Jingde year 1, first month, day bingchen, at night: the capital suffered an earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 1, first month, on the bingchen night, the capital was shaken by an earthquake;

sentences.zh: 癸卯夜，复震；

translations.literal: On the guimao night it shook again;
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao night the capital trembled again;

sentences.zh: 丁未夜，又震，屋皆動，有聲，移時方止。

translations.literal: on the dingwei night it shook once more; buildings all moved, with sound, and after a while ceased.
translations.idiomatic: on the dingwei night it shook again—houses swayed and rumbled until, after some time, all was still.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，冀州地震，占云：“土工興，有急令，兵革興。”

translations.literal: Day guichou: Ji Prefecture suffered an earthquake; the prognostication said, "Earthworks rise, urgent orders issue, armies arise."
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Ji Prefecture was shaken; the omen read, "Earthworks will rise, urgent edicts will issue, and armies will take the field."

sentences.zh: 是年，契丹犯塞。

translations.literal: That year the Khitans raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Khitans breached the frontier.

sentences.zh: 二月，益、黎、雅州地震。

translations.literal: Second month: Yi, Li, and Ya prefectures suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Yi, Li, and Ya prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 三月，邢州地震不止。

translations.literal: Third month: Xing Prefecture suffered earthquakes without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Xing Prefecture quaked again and again without respite.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯夜，瀛州地震。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jimao, at night: Ying Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, on the jimao night, Ying Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月，邢州地復震不止。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Xing Prefecture again shook without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Xing Prefecture trembled ceaselessly once more.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，日南至，京師地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi, on the winter solstice: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the renzi day—the winter solstice—the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，石州地震。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Shi Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Shi Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四年七月丙戌，益州地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, seventh month, day bingxu: Yizhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 4, seventh month, on the bingxu day, Yizhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己丑，渭州瓦亭砦地震者四。

translations.literal: Day jichou: there were four earthquakes at Wating Fort, Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Wating Fort in Wei Prefecture was shaken four times.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年三月，代州地震。

translations.literal: Dazhong Xiangfu year 2, third month: Dai Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 2, third month: Dai Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，昌、眉州並地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month: Chang and Mei prefectures both suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Dazhong Xiangfu 4, sixth month: Chang and Mei prefectures were both shaken.

sentences.zh: 七月，真定府地震，壞城壘。

translations.literal: Seventh month: Zhending Prefecture suffered an earthquake that destroyed city walls and fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: an earthquake struck Zhending Prefecture and breached its walls and ramparts.

sentences.zh: 天聖五年三月，秦州地震。

translations.literal: Tiansheng year 5, third month: Qin Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng 5, third month: Qin Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 七年，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 7: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Tiansheng 7: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 景祐四年十二月甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: Jingyou year 4, twelfth month, day jiazi: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou 4, twelfth month, on the jiazi day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲申，忻、代、并三州地震，壞廬舍，覆壓吏民。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Xin, Dai, and Bing prefectures suffered earthquakes that destroyed buildings and buried officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day earthquakes struck Xin, Dai, and Bing prefectures, crushing buildings and burying officials and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 忻州死者萬九千七百四十二人，傷者五千六百五十五人，畜擾死者五萬餘；

translations.literal: In Xin Prefecture the dead numbered 19,742, the wounded 5,655, and livestock disturbed to death more than 50,000;
translations.idiomatic: At Xin Prefecture 19,742 people died, 5,655 were wounded, and more than fifty thousand head of livestock perished in the panic;

sentences.zh: 代州死者七百五十九人，并州千八百九十人。

translations.literal: in Dai Prefecture the dead numbered 759, and in Bing Prefecture 1,890.
translations.idiomatic: at Dai Prefecture 759 died, and at Bing Prefecture 1,890.

sentences.zh: 寶元元年正月庚申，并、忻、代三州地震。

translations.literal: Baoyuan year 1, first month, day gengshen: Bing, Xin, and Dai prefectures suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyuan 1, first month, on the gengshen day, Bing, Xin, and Dai prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on the jiazi day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 慶曆三年五月九日，忻州地大震，說者曰：“地道貴靜，今數震搖，兵興民勞之像也。”

translations.literal: Qingli year 3, fifth month, ninth day: Xin Prefecture suffered a great earthquake; commentators said, "The earthly way values stillness; now it shakes repeatedly—a sign of war rising and people toiling."
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 3, fifth month, ninth day: Xin Prefecture was struck by a major earthquake; commentators said, "The way of earth prizes stillness—yet now it trembles again and again, the image of war rising and the people worn to exhaustion."

sentences.zh: 四年五月庚午，忻州地震，西北有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Qingli year 4, fifth month, day gengwu: Xin Prefecture suffered an earthquake; from the northwest there came a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 4, fifth month, on the gengwu day, Xin Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake, and from the northwest a sound like thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 五年七月十四日，廣州地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, seventh month, fourteenth day: Guangzhou suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 5, seventh month, on the fourteenth day, Guangzhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六年二月戊寅，青州地震。

translations.literal: Year 6, second month, day wuyin: Qing Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 6, second month, on the wuyin day, Qing Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，登州地震，岠嵎山摧。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: Deng Prefecture suffered an earthquake, and Juyu Mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on the gengyin day, Deng Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake, and Juyu Mountain gave way.

sentences.zh: 自是震不已，每震，則海底有聲如雷。

translations.literal: From this time the shaking did not cease; with each tremor, from beneath the sea came a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the tremors never stopped; each time the earth shook, a sound like thunder rose from beneath the sea.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on the jiashen day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 七年十月乙丑，河陽、許州地震。

translations.literal: Year 7, tenth month, day yichou: Heyang and Xuzhou suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Qingli 7, tenth month, on the yichou day, Heyang and Xuzhou were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 皇祐二年十一月丁酉夜，秀州地震，有聲自北起如雷。

translations.literal: Huangyou year 2, eleventh month, night of dingyou: Xiuzhou suffered an earthquake; a sound rose from the north like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Huangyou 2, eleventh month, on the night of the dingyou day, Xiuzhou was shaken by an earthquake, and a sound like thunder rolled up from the north.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐二年，雄州北界、幽州地大震，大壞城郭，覆壓者數万人。

translations.literal: Jiayou year 2: at the northern border of Xiong Prefecture and You Prefecture a great earthquake greatly destroyed city walls and buildings; tens of thousands were buried.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 2: a major earthquake struck the northern borderlands of Xiong and You prefectures, shattering walls and towns; tens of thousands were crushed beneath the ruins.

sentences.zh: 五年五月己丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, fifth month, day jichou: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiayou 5, fifth month, on the jichou day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 治平四年秋，漳、泉、建州、邵武、興化軍等處皆地震，潮州尤甚，拆裂泉湧，壓覆州郭及兩縣屋宇，士民、軍兵死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Zhiping year 4, autumn: Zhang, Quan, and Jian prefectures, Shaowu, Xinghua Army, and other places all suffered earthquakes; Chaozhou was especially severe—splits opened and springs gushed forth, crushing the prefectural seat and buildings in two counties; very many officials, commoners, and soldiers died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiping 4, autumn: earthquakes struck Zhang, Quan, and Jian prefectures, Shaowu, Xinghua Army, and other districts; Chaozhou suffered worst of all—ground split open and springs burst forth, burying the prefectural city and buildings across two counties; officials, commoners, and soldiers died in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on the jisi day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年七月甲申，地震。

translations.literal: Xining year 1, seventh month, day jiashen: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 1, seventh month, on the jiashen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 乙酉、辛卯，再震；

translations.literal: On the yiyou and xinmao days it shook again;
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou and xinmao days it trembled again;

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅、甲辰，又震。

translations.literal: eighth month, on the renyin and jiachen days, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: in the eighth month, on the renyin and jiachen days, it shook once more.

sentences.zh: 是月，須城、東阿二縣地震終日，滄州清池、莫州亦震，壞官私廬舍、城壁。

translations.literal: That month, Xucheng and Dong'e counties shook all day; Qingchi in Cang Prefecture and Mo Prefecture also shook, destroying official and private buildings and city walls.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xucheng and Dong'e counties trembled all day long; Qingchi in Cang Prefecture and Mo Prefecture were shaken as well, and official and private buildings and city walls were wrecked.

sentences.zh: 是時，河北復大震，或數刻不止，有聲如雷，樓櫓、民居多摧覆，壓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: At that time Hebei again suffered great earthquakes, sometimes continuing for several quarters of an hour without stopping; there were sounds like thunder; watchtowers and common dwellings were largely destroyed, and very many were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hebei was struck again by major earthquakes that sometimes lasted several quarters of an hour without pause, thundering as they ran; watchtowers and homes were toppled in large numbers, and a great many people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，莫州地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuzi: Mo Prefecture suffered an earthquake with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the wuzi day, Mo Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake accompanied by a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，京師及莫州地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: the capital and Mo Prefecture suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the yiwei day, both the capital and Mo Prefecture were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，瀛州地大震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao: Ying Prefecture suffered a great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on the guimao day, Ying Prefecture was struck by a major earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，冀州地震。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Ji Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Ji Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滄州地震，湧出沙泥、船板、胡桃、螺蚌之屬。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Cang Prefecture suffered an earthquake, disgorging sand and mud, ship planks, walnuts, snails and mussels, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Cang Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake that spewed up sand and mud, ship timbers, walnuts, snails, mussels, and the like.

sentences.zh: 是月，潮州地再震。

translations.literal: That month, Chaozhou shook again.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chaozhou was shaken again.

sentences.zh: 是歲，數路地震，有一日十數震，有逾半年震不止者。

translations.literal: That year earthquakes struck across several circuits; in some places there were a dozen or more tremors in a single day, and in some they continued for more than half a year without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: That year earthquakes ran through several circuits—some districts felt a dozen or more shocks in a single day, and in others the ground did not stop trembling for more than half a year.

sentences.zh: 二年十月庚戌，南郊，東壝門內地陷，有天寶十三年古墓。

translations.literal: Year 2, tenth month, day gengxu: at the Southern Suburb, ground within the eastern spirit-wall gate sank, revealing an ancient tomb from Tianbao year 13.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 2, tenth month, on the gengxu day, at the Southern Suburb the ground inside the eastern spirit-wall gate collapsed, exposing an ancient tomb dating to Tianbao 13.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，邕州佛像動搖。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng year 1: the Buddha image in Yong Prefecture swayed.
translations.idiomatic: the first year of Yuanfeng: the Buddha image at Yong Prefecture began to sway.

sentences.zh: 初，像動而夏人入寇，又動而州大火，其後儂智高叛，復動，於是知州錢師孟投其像於江中。

translations.literal: At first, when the image moved the Tangut people invaded; when it moved again the prefecture suffered a great fire; afterward, when Nong Zhigao rebelled it moved again—whereupon Prefect Qian Shimeng cast the image into the river.
translations.idiomatic: At first the image swayed and the Tanguts raided; it swayed again and the prefecture was consumed by a great fire; later, when Nong Zhigao rose in rebellion, it swayed once more—whereupon Prefect Qian Shimeng had the image thrown into the river.

sentences.zh: 八年二月甲戌，賓州嶺方縣地陷。

translations.literal: Year 8, second month, day jiaxu: the ground sank in Lingfang County, Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: the eighth year of Yuanfeng, second month, on the jiaxu day, the earth subsided in Lingfang County, Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on the bingwu day, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年二月辛亥，代州地震有聲。

translations.literal: Yuanyou year 2, second month, day xinhai: Daizhou suffered an earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 2, second month, on the xinhai day, Daizhou was shaken by an earthquake accompanied by rumbling.

sentences.zh: 四年春，陝西、河北地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, spring: Shaanxi and Hebei suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 4, spring: earthquakes struck Shaanxi and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 七年九月己酉，蘭州、鎮戎軍、永興軍地震，十月庚戌朔，環州地再震。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, ninth month, day jiyou: Lanzhou, Zhenrong Army, and Yongxing Army suffered earthquakes; tenth month, first day gengxu, Huan Prefecture shook again.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 7, ninth month, on the jiyou day, Lanzhou, Zhenrong Army, and Yongxing Army were shaken; on the first day of the tenth month, gengxu, Huan Prefecture trembled again.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年十一月丙戌，大原府地震。

translations.literal: Shaosheng year 1, eleventh month, day bingxu: Taiyuan Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 1, eleventh month, on the bingxu day, Taiyuan Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二年十月、十一月，河南府地震。

translations.literal: Year 2, tenth and eleventh months: Henan Prefecture suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 2, in the tenth and eleventh months, Henan Prefecture was shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蘇州自夏迄秋地震。

translations.literal: That year Suzhou shook from summer through autumn.
translations.idiomatic: That year Suzhou trembled from summer until autumn.

sentences.zh: 三年三月戊戌夜，劍南東川地震。

translations.literal: Year 3, third month, night of wuxu: Jiannan East Circuit suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 3, third month, on the night of the wuxu day, Jiannan East Circuit was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，滁州、沂州地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiyou: Chuzhou and Yizhou suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the jiyou day, Chuzhou and Yizhou were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 四年六月己酉，太原府地震有聲。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month, day jiyou: Taiyuan Prefecture suffered an earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 4, sixth month, on the jiyou day, Taiyuan Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake accompanied by rumbling.

sentences.zh: 元符元年七月壬申夜，雲陰蔽天，地震良久。

translations.literal: Yuanfu year 1, seventh month, night of renshen: clouds darkened the sky, and the earthquake lasted a long while.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 1, seventh month, on the night of the renshen day, clouds blotted out the sky and the earth shook for a long time.

sentences.zh: 二年正月壬申，恩州地震。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month, day renshen: En Prefecture suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 2, first month, on the renshen day, En Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，太原府地震；

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Taiyuan Prefecture suffered an earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on the jiaxu day, Taiyuan Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake;

sentences.zh: 三年五月己巳，太原府又震。

translations.literal: year 3, fifth month, day jisi: Taiyuan Prefecture shook again.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu 3, fifth month, on the jisi day, Taiyuan Prefecture trembled again.

sentences.zh: 建中靖國元年十一月辛亥，太原府、潞、晉、隰、代、石、嵐等州岢嵐威勝保化寧化軍地震彌旬，晝夜不止，壞城壁、屋宇，人畜多死。

translations.literal: In Jianzhong Jingguo 1, eleventh month, on xinhai day, Taiyuan Prefecture, Lu, Jin, Xi, Dai, Shi, Lan, and other prefectures, and the Kelan, Weisheng, Baohua, and Ninghua commanderies had earthquakes for a full ten days, day and night without stopping, damaging city walls and houses, and many people and livestock died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day in the eleventh month of Jianzhong Jingguo 1, earthquakes shook Taiyuan Prefecture; Lu, Jin, Xi, Dai, Shi, Lan, and other prefectures; and Kelan, Weisheng, Baohua, and Ninghua commanderies for ten straight days and nights. City walls and buildings were damaged, and many people and livestock died.

sentences.zh: 自後有司方言祥瑞，郡國地震多抑而不奏。

translations.literal: After this, because the offices were speaking of auspicious omens, earthquakes in commanderies and states were often suppressed and not reported.
translations.idiomatic: After this, with officials busy reporting auspicious omens, earthquakes in the commanderies and states were often suppressed and not memorialized.

sentences.zh: 政和七年六月，詔曰：“熙河、環慶、涇原路地震經旬，城砦、關堡、城壁、樓櫓、官私廬舍並皆摧塌，居民覆壓死傷甚眾，而有司不以聞，其遣官按視之。”

translations.literal: Zhenghe year 7, sixth month, an edict said: "The Xihe, Huanqing, and Jingyuan circuits have been shaken by earthquakes for weeks; fort cities, garrison stockades, passes, walls, watchtowers, and official and private dwellings have all collapsed; very many residents have been buried, crushed, killed, and wounded; yet the responsible offices have not reported this—dispatch officials to inspect and assess."
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 7, sixth month, an edict declared: "Earthquakes have shaken the Xihe, Huanqing, and Jingyuan circuits for weeks on end; fortified towns, garrison stockades, passes, walls, watchtowers, and both official and private dwellings have all collapsed; a great many people have been buried alive, crushed, killed, or wounded; yet the responsible offices have failed to report it—send officials to investigate on the spot."

sentences.zh: 宣和四年，北方用兵，雄州地大震。

translations.literal: Xuanhe year 4, while the north was at war, Xiong Prefecture suffered a great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 4, as war raged in the north, Xiong Prefecture was struck by a major earthquake.

sentences.zh: 玄武見於州之正寢，有龜大如錢，蛇若朱漆箸，相逐而行，宣撫使焚香再拜，以銀奩貯二物。

translations.literal: The Dark Warrior appeared in the main hall of the prefecture: a tortoise as large as a coin and a snake like a lacquered chopstick, pursuing each other; the Military Commissioner burned incense and bowed twice, and stored both creatures in a silver casket.
translations.idiomatic: The Dark Warrior manifested in the prefecture's main hall—a tortoise the size of a coin and a snake like a vermilion-lacquered chopstick, chasing each other across the floor; the Military Commissioner burned incense and bowed twice, then placed both creatures in a silver casket.

sentences.zh: 俄俱死。

translations.literal: Soon both died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long both were dead.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，京師連日地震，宮殿門皆動有聲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month: the capital shook day after day; palace gates all rattled audibly.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 6, first month: the capital trembled day after day, and every palace gate shook with an audible rattle.

sentences.zh: 七年七月己亥，熙河路地震，有裂數十丈者，蘭州尤甚。

translations.literal: Year 7, seventh month, day jihai: Xihe Circuit suffered an earthquake; some fissures were several dozen zhang wide; Lanzhou suffered most severely.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhe 7, seventh month, on the jihai day, Xihe Circuit was shaken by an earthquake; some rents in the earth ran several dozen zhang long; Lanzhou suffered worst of all.

sentences.zh: 陷數百家，倉庫俱沒。

translations.literal: Several hundred households sank; storehouses were all submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred households were swallowed up, and every storehouse was buried.

sentences.zh: 河東諸郡或震裂。

translations.literal: Various prefectures in Hedong also split from the shaking.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures across Hedong also cracked open in the tremors.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年正月戊戌，長安地大震，金將婁宿圍城，彌旬無外援，乘地震而入，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Jianyan year 2, first month, day wuxu: Chang'an suffered a great earthquake; the Jin general Lou Su besieged the city; for more than ten days there was no outside relief; they exploited the earthquake to enter, and the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyan 2, first month, on the wuxu day, Chang'an was struck by a major earthquake; the Jin general Lou Su had the city under siege, and for more than ten days no relief came from outside—the besiegers seized the moment of the earthquake to break in, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年八月甲申，地震，平江府、湖州尤甚。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 3, eighth month, day jiashen: there was an earthquake; Pingjiang Prefecture and Huzhou were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 3, eighth month, on the jiashen day, the earth shook; Pingjiang Prefecture and Huzhou were hit hardest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，劉豫陷鄧、隨等州，金人犯蜀。

translations.literal: That year Liu Yu captured Deng, Sui, and other prefectures; the Jurchens invaded Shu.
translations.idiomatic: That year Liu Yu took Deng, Sui, and other prefectures, and the Jurchens invaded Shu.

sentences.zh: 四年，四川地震。

translations.literal: Year 4: Sichuan suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 4: Sichuan was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，行都地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, fifth month: the mobile capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 5, fifth month: the mobile capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六年六月乙巳夜，地震自西北，有聲如雷，餘杭縣為甚。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, sixth month, night of yisi: an earthquake came from the northwest with a sound like thunder; Yuhang County was worst hit.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 6, sixth month, on the night of the yisi day, the earth shook from the northwest with a sound like thunder; Yuhang County suffered most severely.

sentences.zh: 是冬，劉麟、猊犯順，寇濠、壽州。

translations.literal: That winter Liu Lin and Liu Ni violated the truce and raided Hao and Shou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Liu Lin and Liu Ni broke the peace and attacked Hao and Shou prefectures.

sentences.zh: 七年，地震。

translations.literal: Year 7: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 7: the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月戊寅，地震。

translations.literal: Year 24, first month, day wuyin: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 24, first month, on the wuyin day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 二十五年三月壬申，地震。

translations.literal: Year 25, third month, day renshen: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 25, third month, on the renshen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 二十八年八月甲寅夜，震。

translations.literal: Year 28, eighth month, night of jiayin: it shook.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 28, eighth month, on the night of the jiayin day, the ground trembled.

sentences.zh: 三十一年三月壬辰，地震。

translations.literal: Year 31, third month, day renchen: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 31, third month, on the renchen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 三十二年七月戊申，地震。

translations.literal: Year 32, seventh month, day wushen: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 32, seventh month, on the wushen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年十月丁丑，地震；

translations.literal: Longxing year 1, tenth month, day dingchou: there was an earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: Longxing 1, tenth month, on the dingchou day, the earth shook;

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，又震。

translations.literal: sixth month, day jiayin: it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: in the sixth month, on the jiayin day, it trembled again.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年九月丙午，地震自西北方。

translations.literal: Qiandao year 2, ninth month, day bingwu: an earthquake came from the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 2, ninth month, on the bingwu day, the earth shook from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月壬子，石泉軍地震三日，有聲如雷，屋瓦皆落，時綿竹有冤獄雲。

translations.literal: Year 4, twelfth month, day renzi: Shiquan Army shook for three days with a sound like thunder; roof tiles all fell; at the time Mianzhu had portents of unjust imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: Qiandao 4, twelfth month, on the renzi day, Shiquan Army trembled for three days with thunderous rumbling and every roof tile came crashing down; at the time Mianzhu was troubled by omens of wrongful imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年十二月戊辰，地震自東北方。

translations.literal: Chunxi year 1, twelfth month, day wuchen: an earthquake came from the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 1, twelfth month, on the wuchen day, the earth shook from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 九年十二月壬寅夜，地震。

translations.literal: Year 9, twelfth month, night of renyin: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 9, twelfth month, on the night of the renyin day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 十年十二月丙寅，地震。

translations.literal: Year 10, twelfth month, day bingyin: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 10, twelfth month, on the bingyin day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月庚寅，地震。

translations.literal: Year 12, fifth month, day gengyin: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi 12, fifth month, on the gengyin day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 慶元六年九月，東北地震。

translations.literal: Qingyuan year 6, ninth month: there was an earthquake in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 6, ninth month: the northeast was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，地震東北方。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: an earthquake came from the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the jiazi day, the earth shook from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 嘉定六年四月，行都地震。

translations.literal: Jiading year 6, fourth month: the mobile capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 6, fourth month: the mobile capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，淳安縣地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: Chun'an County suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on the bingzi day, Chun'an County was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九年二月辛亥，東、西川地大震四日。

translations.literal: Year 9, second month, day xinhai: East and West Sichuan suffered a great earthquake for four days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 9, second month, on the xinhai day, East and West Sichuan were shaken by a major earthquake that lasted four days.

sentences.zh: 十年二月庚申，地震自東南。

translations.literal: Year 10, second month, day gengshen: an earthquake came from the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 10, second month, on the gengshen day, the earth shook from the southeast.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，地震​​。

translations.literal: Year 12, fifth month: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 12, fifth month: the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 六月，西川地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month: West Sichuan suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: West Sichuan was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月乙未夜，地震，大雷。

translations.literal: Year 14, first month, night of yiwei: there was an earthquake and great thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 14, first month, on the night of the yiwei day, the earth shook amid great thunder.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，西川地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: West Sichuan suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on the bingshen day, West Sichuan was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 寶慶元年八月己酉，地震。

translations.literal: Baoqing year 1, eighth month, day jiyou: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Baoqing 1, eighth month, on the jiyou day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年十二月丙辰，地震。

translations.literal: Jiaxi year 4, twelfth month, day bingchen: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxi 4, twelfth month, on the bingchen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年十二月庚辰夜，地震。

translations.literal: Chunyou year 1, twelfth month, night of gengchen: there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chunyou 1, twelfth month, on the night of the gengchen day, the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 寶祐三年，蜀地震。

translations.literal: Baoyou year 3: Shu suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyou 3: Shu was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 咸淳七年，嘉定府城震者三。

translations.literal: Xianchun year 7: Jiading Prefecture city shook three times.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 7: the city of Jiading Prefecture trembled three times.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，階州福津縣常峽山圮，壅白江水，逆流高十許丈，壞民田數百里。

translations.literal: Yongxi year 3: Changxia Mountain in Fujin County, Jie Prefecture collapsed, damming the Bai River; the backflow rose some ten zhang; farmland for several hundred li was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxi 3: Changxia Mountain in Fujin County, Jie Prefecture, gave way, blocking the Bai River; the water backed up nearly ten zhang high and ruined farmland for several hundred li.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年五月，名山縣大風雨，登遼山圮，壅江水逆流入民田，害稼。

translations.literal: Chunhua year 2, fifth month: Mingshan County suffered great wind and rain; Dengliao Mountain collapsed, damming river water that flowed backward into farmland, harming crops.
translations.idiomatic: Chunhua 2, fifth month: Mingshan County was battered by wind and torrential rain; Dengliao Mountain collapsed, forcing the river back into the fields and destroying the crops.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年七月庚午，寧化軍汾水漲，壞北水門，山石摧圮，軍士有壓死者。

translations.literal: Xianping year 1, seventh month, day gengwu: the Fen River rose at Ninghua Army, destroying the North Water Gate; mountain rocks collapsed; some soldiers were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 1, seventh month, on the gengwu day, the Fen River flooded at Ninghua Army and broke the North Water Gate; mountainside rock gave way, and some soldiers were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 二年七月庚寅，靈寶縣暴雨崖圮，壓居民，死者二十二戶。

translations.literal: Year 2, seventh month, day gengyin: Lingbao County, torrential rain caused cliffs to collapse, crushing residents; twenty-two households died.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 2, seventh month, on the gengyin day, torrential rain at Lingbao County brought cliffs crashing down on dwellings, killing twenty-two households.

sentences.zh: 三年三月辛丑夜，大澤縣三陽砦大雨崖摧，壓死者六十二人。

translations.literal: Year 3, third month, night of xinchou: at Sanyang Stockade in Daze County, heavy rain caused cliffs to crumble; sixty-two were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 3, third month, on the night of the xinchou day, heavy rain at Sanyang Stockade in Daze County shattered the cliffs, crushing sixty-two people to death.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，成紀縣山摧，壓死者六十餘人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month: Chengji County, a mountain collapsed; more than sixty were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping 4, first month: a mountain at Chengji County collapsed, killing more than sixty people.

sentences.zh: 景德四年七月，成紀縣崖圮，壓死居民。

translations.literal: Jingde year 4, seventh month: Chengji County cliff collapsed, crushing residents to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jingde 4, seventh month: a cliff at Chengji County gave way, burying residents alive.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年九月丙寅，華州少華山前阜頭峰越八盤領及谷，摧陷於石子坡。

translations.literal: Xining year 5, ninth month, day bingyin: at Shaohua Mountain in Hua Prefecture, Front Futu Peak crossed over Balpan Ridge and the valley and collapsed into Shizi Slope.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 5, ninth month, on the bingyin day, at Shaohua Mountain in Hua Prefecture, Front Futu Peak slid over Balpan Ridge and the valley and collapsed onto Shizi Slope.

sentences.zh: 東西五里，南北十里，潰散墳裂，湧起堆阜，各高數丈，長若堤岸。

translations.literal: East to west five li, north to south ten li—the ground burst and split, mounds surged up each several zhang high, long like dikes.
translations.idiomatic: For five li east to west and ten li north to south the earth burst open and split apart; heaps of debris rose several zhang high, stretching like earthen dikes.

sentences.zh: 至陷居民六社，凡數百戶，林木、廬舍亦無存者。

translations.literal: In all six village communities of residents sank, totaling several hundred households; trees and dwellings likewise left nothing standing.
translations.idiomatic: Six whole village communities—several hundred households in all—were swallowed up, and not a tree or dwelling was left standing.

sentences.zh: 並山之民言：“數年以來，峰上常有云，每遇風雨，即隱隱有聲。

translations.literal: People near the mountain said: "For several years clouds have often hung on the peak; whenever wind and rain came, a faint rumbling could be heard.
translations.idiomatic: People living by the mountain said: "For years clouds had often gathered on the peak, and whenever wind and rain approached, a low rumble could be heard.

sentences.zh: 是夜初昏，略無風雨，山上忽霧起，有聲漸大，地遂震動，不及食頃而山摧。”

translations.literal: That night at first dusk, with scarcely any wind or rain, fog suddenly rose on the mountain; the sound gradually grew louder; the ground then shook, and in less than the time to eat a meal the mountain collapsed."
translations.idiomatic: That night at early dusk, though there was hardly wind or rain, fog suddenly rolled over the mountain; the sound swelled louder and louder, the ground began to shake, and in less time than it takes to eat a meal the mountain came down."

sentences.zh: 元祐元年十二月，鄭縣界小敷谷山摧，傷居民。

translations.literal: Yuanyou year 1, twelfth month: Xiaofugu Mountain on the border of Zheng County collapsed, injuring residents.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou 1, twelfth month: Xiaofugu Mountain on the Zheng County border gave way, wounding local residents.

sentences.zh: 紹興十二年十二月，陝西不雨，五穀焦枯，涇、渭、灞、滻皆竭。

translations.literal: Shaoxing year 12, twelfth month: Shaanxi had no rain; the five grains withered; the Jing, Wei, Ba, and Chan rivers all ran dry.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing 12, twelfth month: Shaanxi went without rain until the five grains shriveled and the Jing, Wei, Ba, and Chan rivers all dried up.

sentences.zh: 時秦民以飢離散，壯者為北人所買，郡邑遂空。

translations.literal: At the time the people of Qin scattered in famine; strong men were bought by northerners, and the prefectures and counties were left empty.
translations.idiomatic: By then the people of Qin had scattered in hunger; able-bodied men were sold to northerners, and prefectures and counties were left deserted.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年秋，南嶽祝融峰山自摧。

translations.literal: Shaoxi year 4, autumn: Zhurong Peak on the Southern Marchmount collapsed by itself.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 4, autumn: Zhurong Peak on the Southern Marchmount collapsed on its own.

sentences.zh: 劍門關山摧。

translations.literal: Jianmen Pass mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain at Jianmen Pass gave way.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月，臨安府南高峰山自摧。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, twelfth month: South Gaofeng Mountain in Lin'an Prefecture collapsed by itself.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 5, twelfth month: South Gaofeng Mountain in Lin'an Prefecture collapsed on its own.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年六月辛未，台州黃岩縣大雨水，有山自徙五十餘里，其聲如雷，草木、塚墓皆不動，而故址潰為淵潭。

translations.literal: Qingyuan year 2, sixth month, day xinwei: Huangyan County, Taizhou, suffered torrential rain; a mountain moved itself more than fifty li; the sound was like thunder; grass, trees, and tombs all remained unmoved, but the former site collapsed into a deep pool.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan 2, sixth month, on the xinwei day, torrential rain struck Huangyan County in Taizhou; a mountain shifted more than fifty li with a sound like thunder—grass, trees, and graves stayed where they were, but the ground it had left collapsed into a deep abyss.

sentences.zh: 時臨海縣清潭山亦自移。

translations.literal: At the time Qingtan Mountain in Linhai County also moved by itself.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Qingtan Mountain in Linhai County shifted on its own as well.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰二年七月丁未，閩建安縣山摧，民廬之壓者六十餘家。

translations.literal: Jiatai year 2, seventh month, day dingwei: in Jian'an County, Min, a mountain collapsed; more than sixty households of common dwellings were crushed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiatai 2, seventh month, on the dingwei day, a mountain at Jian'an County in Min gave way, crushing more than sixty common households.

sentences.zh: 嘉定六年六月丙子，嚴州淳安縣長樂鄉山摧水湧。

translations.literal: Jiading year 6, sixth month, day bingzi: in Changle Township, Chun'an County, Yanzhou, a mountain collapsed and water gushed forth.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 6, sixth month, on the bingzi day, at Changle Township in Chun'an County, Yanzhou, a mountain collapsed and water burst forth.

sentences.zh: 九年，黎州山崩。

translations.literal: Year 9: Lizhou mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading 9: a mountain at Lizhou gave way.

sentences.zh: 咸淳十年，天目山崩。

translations.literal: Xianchun year 10: Tianmu Mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 10: Tianmu Mountain came down.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年，荊、襄間天雨白犛如馬尾，長者尺餘，瀰漫山谷。

translations.literal: Xining year 1: between Jing and Xiang, heaven rained white yak hair like horse tails, the longest over a chi, filling the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 1: between Jing and Xiang, white yak hair like horse tails fell from the sky—some strands more than a chi long—blanketing the valleys.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，潭州雨毛。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: Tan Prefecture suffered rain of hair.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on the dingyou day, hair rained down on Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八年五月丁丑，雨黃毛。

translations.literal: Year 8, fifth month, day dingchou: yellow hair rained down.
translations.idiomatic: Xining 8, fifth month, on the dingchou day, yellow hair fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 紹熙四年十一月癸酉，地生毛。

translations.literal: Shaoxi year 4, eleventh month, day guiyou: the ground grew hair.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxi 4, eleventh month, on the guiyou day, hair sprouted from the earth.

sentences.zh: 咸淳九年，江南平地產白毛，臨安尤多。

translations.literal: Xianchun year 9: Jiangnan flatlands produced white hair; Lin'an especially had much.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchun 9: white hair grew from the flatlands of Jiangnan, and Lin'an had more than anywhere else.
